隔壁小王（全息）作者：易人北 Xiao Wang next door (holographic) Author: Yi Renbei
文案： Copy:
13区所有人都知道隔壁小王不是隔壁老王的儿子。 Everyone in District 13 knows that Xiao Wang next door is not the son of Lao Wang next door.
但他们不知道隔壁小王重生了。 But they didn't know that Xiao Wang next door was reborn.
王叶原名王野种，他爸给他到派出所亲自报的名字，派出所的人把老王教训了一通，给小王重新取名叫王叶。
Wang Ye's original name was Wang Yechong, and his father gave him the name he reported to the police station in person, and the people at the police station taught Lao Wang a lesson and renamed Xiao Wang Ye again.
王叶小时候受的磋磨太多，没长成小可怜，却异变成了乖戾偏执桀骜不驯不信任任何人的阴狠魔鬼。
Wang Ye suffered too much when he was a child, and he didn't grow into a little pitiful, but he turned into a ruthless devil who was obedient, paranoid, unruly, and distrustful of anyone.
当跟所有敌人同归于尽的一刻，他放松地想着：TMD总算死了，这辈子也算值了，就这样吧。
When he died with all the enemies, he relaxed and thought: TMD is finally dead, and this life is worth it, so be it.
谁想，他竟然重生了，且重生在最操蛋的小时候。 Who would have thought that he was actually reborn, and reborn in the most fucked-up childhood.
这时候全世界刚刚推出一款游戏，名为《极度危险》，很多人说这就是全息游戏，但也有人说这就是新的异世界。
At this time, the world had just launched a game called "Extremely Dangerous", and many people said that this was a holographic game, but others said that this was a new different world.
上辈子超级贫穷的王叶直到十九岁才有机会进入这款游戏，那时他已经落后很多人。但就算这样，他还是凭借着他的狠辣、不怕死以及超级没下限的人品，在这个世界挣出了他的一片天地，之后更发现了这个世界的秘密……
Wang Ye, who was super poor in his previous life, didn't have the opportunity to enter this game until he was nineteen years old, and he was already a lot behind by then. But even so, he still relied on his ruthlessness, not afraid of death and super unbounded character to earn his piece of the world in this world, and then discovered the secrets of this world......
现在重生归来，他对把已经搞死过的敌人全都再搞死一遍已经没兴趣，那就玩玩游戏吧。
Now that he's back from rebirth, he's not interested in killing all the enemies he's already killed again, so let's play the game.
嗯，就随便玩玩~ Well, just play around~

第1章 被扔进海里 Chapter 1: Thrown into the sea
“船长，船舱里发现一个小孩。” "Captain, a child was found in the cabin."
大副禀告的同时，让人把一个男孩提了过来。 At the same time as the first mate made a statement, someone brought a boy over.
男孩身形很瘦小，也许六七岁，也许七八岁，皮肤偏黄，浑身都没二两肉，瘦得能看见肋骨，只腰间围了一块破布。
The boy was very thin, maybe six or seven years old, maybe seven or eight years old, with yellowish skin, no flesh on his body, so thin that he could see his ribs, and only a rag around his waist.
提着男孩的水手把男孩往船板上一扔。 The sailor carrying the boy threw the boy onto the board.
男孩趴在地上，慢慢蜷缩成一团。 The boy lay on the ground, slowly curled up in a ball.
船长皱眉，男孩身上青青肿肿都是伤，后脑勺很可能有伤口，短发和血黏成一团。左胳膊耷拉着，九成骨折了。
The captain frowned, the boy was bruised and swollen, and there was probably a wound on the back of his head, and the short hair and blood were sticking together. His left arm was hanging and ninety percent broken.
船长用脚翻过男孩正面，就见男孩腹部有大片的暗红色，这种伤可不好治，很可能是内伤。
The captain turned over the boy's front with his foot, and saw that the boy's abdomen was a large dark red color, which was not a good injury, and it was probably an internal injury.
男孩睁开眼睛看向船长。 The boy opened his eyes and looked at the captain.
船长突然发出嗤笑，这男孩闭着眼睛的时候看起来特弱小，但一睁开眼，就从头到脚浑身都散发出“我是刺头”之感。
The captain sneered, the boy looked very weak when his eyes were closed, but when he opened his eyes, he exuded a sense of "I am a thorn" from head to toe.
“扔掉。”船长没有半丝犹豫地下令。 "Throw it away." The captain gave the order without hesitation.
男孩的伤势一看就很不好治，就算能救得活，卖掉他能卖几个钱？海上药物多贵重，十个男孩都不够药钱的。
The boy's injuries are very difficult to treat at first glance, even if he can be saved, how much money can he sell for him? The medicine at sea is so expensive that ten boys are not enough to pay for it.
留下干活？这么小这么瘦弱的小孩能干什么活？而且这小孩看着可不像是感恩戴德的老实人。
Stay and work? What can such a small and thin child do? And this kid doesn't look like an honest man who is grateful to Dade.
船员没有二话，提起男孩就要往甲板走。 The crew didn't say a word, and when they mentioned the boy, they were about to go to the deck.
大副想到自家很长时间没有见到面的独子，生出了一点点恻隐之心：“前面就要到海草岛了，不如到那里再把他丢了吧。能活也是他的运气，不能活就是他的命。”
The first mate thought of his only son, whom he hadn't seen for a long time, and felt a little compassion: "I'm going to Seagrass Island in front, so it's better to throw him away there." It's his luck to be alive, and it's his life not to live. ”
船长冷笑：“这小子不买船票就偷上我的船，还想我把他带到海草岛？船上不是还有两个刚死的吗，一起扔了。”
The captain sneered: "This kid stole my boat without buying a ticket, and still wants me to take him to Seagrass Island?" Didn't there be two more who had just died on the ship, and they threw them together. ”
海草岛？这名字有点熟悉。男孩正在回忆他在哪儿听过这个名字。
Seagrass Island? The name is somewhat familiar. The boy was recalling where he had heard the name.
“是，船长！”船员再度提起男孩，他还故意捏他折断的左臂，怪笑道：“小子，带你去见海神，下辈子记得不要随便偷上别人的船。”
"Yes, Captain!" The crew mentioned the boy again, and he deliberately pinched his broken left arm, and said with a strange smile: "Boy, take you to see the sea god, remember not to steal someone else's ship casually in the next life." ”
大副皱皱眉头，“好了，这小孩交给我。你去处理那两具尸体。”
The first mate frowned, "Okay, I'll give this kid to me." You go and dispose of those two bodies. ”
船员不敢不听大副的话，把男孩交给大副。 The crew did not dare to disobey the first mate and handed over the boy to the first mate.
男孩完好的右手从船员手指和腰间一掠而过，速度快得惊人。
The boy's intact right hand swept past the crew's fingers and waist with astonishing speed.
那船员半点没有发现，喊了其他两个水手去搬尸体。 The crew didn't notice it at all, and called the other two sailors to move the body.
“尽量往左边那座岛游。”大副贴着男孩的耳朵快速地说道。
"Try to swim to the island on the left." The first mate spoke quickly to the boy's ear.
噗通，男孩最终还是被扔进了海里。 Poof, the boy was eventually thrown into the sea.
娘的，白嫖的果然没有人权。王叶抱着一个打水的破木桶浮出水面，吐出一口腥咸的海水。破木桶是大副塞给他的。他欠了大副一份因果，等以后有机会还吧。
Damn, the white prostitutes really have no human rights. Wang Ye surfaced with a broken wooden bucket for water and spat out a mouthful of salty seawater. The broken barrel was given to him by the first mate. He owes the first mate a piece of karma, and he will have a chance to pay it back later.
还好，刚才在船上他就看到附近有两座几乎平行的岛屿，游过去最多三五百米。运气更好的是，现在正是涨潮的时候。
Fortunately, just now on the boat, he saw two islands that were almost parallel to each other, swimming up to three or five hundred meters. Even luckier, it's time for high tide.
后脑勺和身上的伤口被海水腌得有点闷疼，但并不是那么难以忍受，他对疼痛的耐受度非常高，在别人那儿能达到九级的疼痛，在他这儿顶多三级。就是脑子晕乎乎的，这是脑震荡的后遗症。
The wounds on the back of his head and body were a little stuffy with the seawater, but they weren't so unbearable, and his tolerance to pain was very high, reaching level nine in others, and at most level three in his case. It's the dizziness of the brain, which is the sequelae of a concussion.
王叶把从船员那儿摸来的戒指套到大拇指上，钱袋只能放到破木桶里。对方扔他一次，捏他断臂一次，就用这枚戒指和钱袋做补偿吧。
Wang Ye put the ring he had touched from the crew on his thumb, and the money bag could only be placed in the broken barrel. The other party threw him once, pinched him once, and used this ring and money bag as compensation.
同时他还得到了两份因果之力。 At the same time, he also received two copies of the power of cause and effect.
一份来自船员，一份来自那名船长。 One from the crew, one from the captain.
他没付钱坐了人家的船，船长把他扔下海，也算了结一份因果。
He didn't pay for the ride on someone's boat, and the captain threw him overboard, and he settled a cause and effect.
王叶吸收了两份因果之力，身体里总算有了一点点能量，随后放松身体，把脑袋搁在木桶边沿，任由海浪推着他往海岛前行。
Wang Ye absorbed two parts of the power of cause and effect, and finally had a little energy in his body, then relaxed his body, rested his head on the edge of the barrel, and let the waves push him towards the island.
这是他重生第二天，他压根就没想过要这么快进入游戏，毕竟这款游戏的入门费可不低，最便宜的游戏头盔都要一万八千八，传说中的游戏舱更是价格高达十八万八。

谁想，他不过因为料理完某个人渣，太累了睡了一会儿，再醒来就在游戏中。
Who would have thought, he was just too tired to sleep for a while because he was too tired after cooking a certain scumbag, and then woke up in the game.
更神奇的是，他似乎不是脑电波进入，而是真身进入。 What's even more amazing is that he doesn't seem to have brain waves entering, but real body entering.

It's a pity that he doesn't dare to try, if he tries out, he only has one life, who will he cry to when he dies?

《极度危险》这个破游戏有很多非常坑爹的设定，其中最著名也最让玩家抗议的两个就是：该游戏没有一般游戏都会配置的空间背包，也没有初始技能。
"Extreme Danger" is a broken game with a lot of very cheating settings, and the two most famous and the most protested by players are: the game does not have a space backpack that is usually configured in games, and there is no initial skill.

Want a space backpack? Yes, you can find and buy it yourself, or learn how to make it yourself.
想要技能？只有一个方法，去学习，脚踏实地实实在在的学习。想要摁个按键就把技能学会并释放出来？做梦！
Want skills? There is only one way to learn, to learn in a down-to-earth manner. Want to learn and unleash a skill at the touch of a button? Dream!
不过这个游戏有一个好处，那就是玩家能把自己学过并掌握的技能带入到游戏世界并使用出来。

噗通，噗通。 Puff, puff.

If you look closely, you can see that these sea fish are biting Wang Ye's hair, no, to be precise, they are biting the wound on the back of his head, and they look greedy and eager to burrow into his head.

不行，得赶紧出水。 No, you have to get out of the water quickly.

Wang Ye turned around and swam towards the largest reef he could see nearby, and he had to try to climb to the reef while he still had some strength, and wait for the tide to go back before thinking about going ashore.

Anyone who has swam knows that there is a lot of buoyancy in the water, especially the seawater, but when you come out of the seawater, the whole body is as if it is pulled by the seawater, and it is very heavy.
王叶又只有一支胳膊可以用，提了几次都没能把自己成功提上礁石。他倒是想把两只脚也踩到礁石上，但他人小，现在又正是涨潮的时候，两只脚踩不到地面，也没办法像爬山一样踩到礁石上。
Wang Ye only had one arm to use, and he couldn't lift himself up the reef after lifting it a few times. He wanted to put his two feet on the reef as well, but he was small, and it was the time of high tide, so he couldn't step on the ground with two feet, and he couldn't step on the reef like a mountain.
王叶尝试了几次，累得筋疲力尽，索性就用单只手扣住礁石缝隙，把自己挂在了礁石上。
Wang Ye tried several times, but he was exhausted, so he simply clasped the gap in the reef with one hand and hung himself on the reef.
后面鱼群一直在尾随着他，还有海蛇游了过来。 The fish followed him, and the sea serpent swam over.

悬崖下面也是大片的礁石，还夹杂着一个很小的沙滩。

说是木船，其实就是粗树干中间被掏空，两头和船底略微修整了下。
这小木舟头部撞了一个大洞，四周的木头都裂开了，只能当废弃物。
小木舟被废弃的时间可能比较长了，船底四周包括船舱里面都长满了藤壶和青口贝。
王叶把木桶刷洗干净，从小木舟上扒了大半桶藤壶和青口贝，又去礁石那儿扒了些牡蛎。
在礁石滩翻捡了半天也没找到适合的石块，王叶担心雷木，只好往回走。
走到一半时，他感到周围好像有人在看他，他对目光很敏感，尤其是对他怀有恶意的目光。
盯着他看的目光也许不含恶意，但也没什么善意。
王叶假装走不动路，放下木桶原地歇了一会儿，顺便看了看周围风景。
就在旁边的崖壁上有几个连起来的崖洞，从光亮处往里看，只能看到一团黑。但王叶很肯定，刚才盯他的目光就是从那边过来。
只要人不主动招惹他，王叶也不想多管闲事，权当什么都没发现，拎起木桶继续向悬崖顶端走。
作者有话要说：
崖洞内神秘人：这个小孩没见过，需要注意。
第9章 晚饭
回到石洞，海蛋已经回来了，并把防蚊虫的药草丢进了火堆里，还给他们留了一些。
火堆边还放有几根约三指粗的长木枝，看着都很结实。
雷木和王叶目光对上，王叶立刻绽开一个大大的笑脸。
雷木忍不住也笑了。他很少看到小孩不怕他，他对自己的纹面很有自知之明，大人看了都觉得悚人，更何况不懂事的小孩？没看那叫海蛋的小孩都不敢看他的脸。
可这叫王叶的男孩胆子真的很大，而且丝毫不在乎他的纹面。有时候他看自己的目光，甚至让他产生一种对方似乎已经和他生活了许多年的错觉。
“你回来啦，弄了些什么？”海蛋好奇地探头来看，结果就看到一堆没什么肉的贝类，当下就嫌弃地道：“你怎么弄这些东西吃？咱村就没人吃这些。”
“怎么？不好吃？”王叶还挺喜欢吃海鲜的。
海蛋摇头：“也不是不好吃，就是吃腻了。这东西特别多，长得到处都是，肉又少，吃多少都吃不饱。”
王叶心想这就是海边人才有的幸福啊，而且是这种海水无工业污染、且没有多少人的海岛土著才能享受到的幸福。
“你们是不是也不吃海蟹？那种硬壳有八只爪子的。”
“当然不吃，那东西又没多少肉，吃起来还麻烦。”海蛋更嫌弃了。
“那你们平时吃什么？”王叶把破木桶放到火堆边，从洞里找了一块较为椭圆的大石头，清洗干净，丢到火堆边炙烤。
海蛋撅着屁股帮忙，边忙边回答：“吃粉果啊，粉果是我们的主食，还有黑猪肉。黑猪原本是野猪，我们岛有好多野猪。村长爷爷去海草村那儿学会了怎么养猪，就逮了小黑猪来养，还会割了那些小猪的蛋蛋。那些小黑猪原本都特别凶，但割了蛋蛋以后就老实了。但我们一年到头也吃不到几次肉，还是吃鱼最多。”
王叶能理解海岛人对肉类和主食的追求，要他天天吃鱼他也受不了：“听起来你们过得还不错，你们不打鱼吗？”
“打鱼啊。但海上打鱼很危险，村里平均半个月才出去一次。平时大家也就是用小船在附近捕捞一些海货吃吃。”
海蛋对看起来就很小的王叶没什么戒心，王叶问什么，他就说什么，没一会儿就把他知道的海沟岛和海沟村的情况秃噜了个干干净净。
王叶从海蛋口中了解到海沟岛物产丰富，果物一年到头都有，山林中野物众多，每天早晚两次赶潮就能捡到足够吃饱的海货，如果不追求吃得好，人们哪怕不出海打鱼也能吃饱喝足。
粉果这种树都不用海沟村人特地种植，满岛屿长得都是，且是多年生，每年都能结果子，结果期还很长。
可能因为食物很容易获得，海沟村人都有点懒，不是不愿意干活那种懒，而是懒得去改变自己的生活，更懒得去发明创造。也没人会去随便吃别人没有吃过的果物、野物和海货。
海沟村能穿上粗布衣，会使用更多工具，变化还是从囚犯岛建立开始。五十年前海草岛那边建起海草村，海沟村人才有了更多交流对象，也学了不少外界知识，但对岛内改变还是很少。
但想想华夏前几千年的老百姓也大多维持着类似的生活方式，一个村庄只要不经历战乱，里面的生活可以几千年都不改变，王叶就能明白海沟村为什么会这样，他们有时候不是不想改变，而是不知道该如何改变和惧怕改变。
“粉果我帮你剖开？”海蛋抱着粉果问。
王叶扭头：“好……啊！”
他真蠢，这不就是现成的锅吗？
粉果果壳很硬，外表像椰子，用牡蛎壳刀不好切，只能用石刀砍。
海蛋抄起石刀砰砰两下就把果壳劈开。
这个大约有足球大的果子里面是满满的湿滑的淀粉。
海蛋告诉王叶，粉果里面的粉不能生吃，必须煮熟。
王叶看海蛋指甲里还带着黑泥的手指直接往果子里面抓，连忙抓住他的手，表示他自己来。这辈子他打算和师父和木头活得长长久久，完全不想给自己的身体留下任何隐患。
上辈子他从四岁开始就不得不负担起家里做饭的职责，等到后来他更是一个人生活，练出了一手还算不错的厨艺。
王叶洗过手，拿过一半的果壳，加了一点清水和海盐粒，两腿夹住果壳，单手把里面的淀粉搅拌成糊状。
等到面糊糊变得粘稠，可以用手团成一团抄起来，王叶就转移到了火堆边。
“你要做什么？”海蛋凑过来，他原本想把面糊糊弄成一团团的放到棕榈叶上，再放到火堆边烤，只要烤熟就能吃。
王叶的做法差不多，不过没用棕榈叶，而是直接把面糊糊往那块烤热的石头上一抹，这是摊煎饼的手法。
淀粉特有的焦香味冒出。
不到数秒，一张薄饼就摊好了。
海蛋看得眼睛一亮。
雷木不想干躺着，也过来帮忙，他把王叶摊好的薄饼从石头上揭下来，放到海蛋准备好的棕榈叶上。
“你躺在那儿别动！伤口再崩裂，我揍你！”王叶特别凶地冲雷木吼道。
雷木：“……我没事。”
“你有事！躺着，等我侍候你。”王叶又让海蛋去洗手，一定要洗得干干净净。
海蛋莫名其妙，但看王叶很凶的样子，乖乖去水眼那里洗手。
洗完了，还特别亮给王叶看。
王叶虽然觉得那双小爪子还脏得很，但也没要他再洗第二遍，而是吩咐海蛋帮忙把烙好的薄饼从石头上揭下来。
“好啊好啊，我来！”海蛋巴不得做这个活计，他觉得好玩。
雷木看没他的事，只好躺下。
一个人烙，一个人揭，速度相当快。
王叶烙了一半，就让大家先把烙好的薄饼吃掉。
薄饼口感很滑很嫩，带着点咸味，很像是王叶在地球吃过的葛根粉饼，对于饥饿的人来说很好吃。
王叶和雷木都饿了，吃起来速度飞快。
海蛋也不弱，丝毫没有客人的自觉，抢食不比王叶慢到哪儿。
随后王叶又把剩下的半个粉果里的淀粉做成团团，一个个摊在石块上烘烤。
如此，两个半球形的果壳就腾空出来了。
王叶毫不愧疚地指示海蛋把他提回来的贝类都清洗干净，把牡蛎剖开。
海蛋翻了个白眼，他们岛民都是直接煮了吃，洗个屁啊。
王叶想到这里的海水没多少污染，勉强接受了只随便冲洗一遍的藤壶和青口贝，把它们全都放到果壳里煮。
作料少，只能撒一点海盐提味。
其实藤壶蒸着更好吃，但现在条件不够只能凑合。
不过海鲜吃的就是一个鲜字，王叶拎来的大半桶藤壶和青口贝都是最新鲜的，哪怕清煮，口感也相当不错。
尤其藤壶这种对于船只和大型鱼类来说的害类，肉质鲜嫩，竟比青口贝更好吃一些。
剖开的牡蛎就放到火堆上烤，烤熟了连带里面的汁水一口吞，也很可口。
就是王叶只有一只手能用，吃东西很不方便。
雷木看王叶瞪着抢食的海蛋运气，好笑地拿过那些海鲜，把里面的肉挑出来，放到王叶面前，但挑了一会儿他的手就颤抖起来。
他被人暗害围杀，除了外伤，筋脉也受了严重损伤，导致手脚无力，就是做这么点小事，都不得劲。
其实他的情况原本可以不用这么糟糕，在那艘船上时，他的伤势已经开始好转，但没想到杀手还是跟了上来，并找到了他。
他拼死干掉杀手，但自己也重伤昏迷过去，最后被那艘船的船长给当做死人扔下船。
落海时，他因为伤口受到海水刺激醒来，不得不冒着加重伤势的危险，从已经受伤的筋脉中逼出力气往岸边游，好不容易爬上一座礁石，还没喘口气，又耗力拉了一个小孩上来。
这么一折腾，他原本开始好转的伤势就来了个翻转，不但没好转，还恶化了。
“你自己吃，不用管我。”王叶也馋，但他直觉雷木比他还需要营养。
海蛋看王叶不方便，这才一脸恍然大悟地道：“我忘了你断了一只手，我帮你弄吧。”
王叶：“……”
雷木也笑，王叶那忙里忙外的勤快小模样，实在是很容易让人忘记他现在是个小残废。
雷木看着后脑勺还带着伤的小孩，心里自然冒出一个疑惑：这娃不怕疼？还是感觉不到疼痛？
吃完海鲜，粉果团团也都烘烤熟了，这种烘烤出来的粉团团带着焦香味，吃到嘴里也不干，最好的是能饱腹。
王叶又用另外半个果壳烧了一锅开水。
这两个半果壳烧过一次后，就有点酥了，不知道是不是还能用第二次。
海蛋没什么信心地摇头道：“能烧一次没烧破就算不错，等我明天给你到大礁石滩那边找找有没有合适的石锅。”
“我和你一起去。”他需要认认路，主要是找找有没有什么有用的东西。
“对了，悬崖那边有些崖洞你知道吧？”王叶似不经意地问道。
海蛋抹嘴点头，“知道啊。”
“那里有人住吗？”
“没有。那里怎么会有人住？那里特别潮湿，洞里都是烂泥，我们都不去那边玩。”
“那岛上除了我和我哥，还有其他外来者吗？”王叶又问。
海蛋继续摇头：“没有了，就你们俩。”
王叶没再多问，他原本打算在海蛋回去时，趁着天还没黑，和他一起去海沟村一趟，但在知道那边崖壁洞里有人后，他就更不放心把雷木一个人留在洞里。
作者有话要说：
雷木：要不要告诉小家伙，我受伤了，但一样能杀人。算了，还是不说了，被小不点照顾的感觉还挺不错的，感觉像是养了一个孝顺儿子。
王叶：我家好大儿要是在我不注意的时候不小心变成药人怎么办，时刻提防。
　
第10章 聚水珠
海蛋走的时候，天边晚霞艳丽万分，就像是出来迎接帝王的盛装妃嫔，当然它们迎接的不是海蛋，那枚红艳艳的大鸡蛋黄才是她们迎接的帝王。
雷木见海蛋离开，突然道：“那个水眼里面有东西。”
“有东西？什么东西？”王叶往水眼望过去。
“不知道，那东西不算很深，大约一根手指深，你看看能不能挖开来。”
【任务发布：守墓人雷木委托玩家隔壁小王寻找水眼中的神秘物品。完成后，奖励50点经验值。请问隔壁小王是否接受这个任务？】
守墓人？王叶心里打了个突，总觉得这个前缀有点阴森和不祥之兆。
“我来看看。”王叶接下任务，拿了石刀就跑去挖掘水眼。
雷木感到一丝诧异，小孩似乎一点都不奇怪他的指点，也没问他为什么知道水眼里有东西，就这么自然而然相信了。
王叶上辈子和雷木一起生活七年多，当然知道雷木有些特异之处。雷木能看到能量的光芒，一般微小的能量光芒他会忽略，比较强的才会被他注意。
雷木的眼睛可以发现宝贝，而他可以鉴定，他们俩搭档，着实淘到了不少好东西。
只可惜上辈子他认识雷木时，雷木已经是没有自我意识的药人，他就算发现宝贝也不会表达，只是有时候会莫名其妙站到某个地方不动，或者一直看着某个地方某个东西。
他还是跟雷木生活久了才发现这点，在这之前也不知漏过了多少好物，这辈子可不能这样了。
细细的淡水从石头裂缝里冒出来，王叶用石刀插进石缝拨弄了好几下，几块碎石掉了下来。
王叶看出水眼变大了一点，就伸手去掏。
手指似乎摸到了什么圆溜溜的东西，王叶手指一勾，把那东西一点点从水眼里抠了出来。
那是一颗只有龙眼大的小石珠，扁扁的，呈椭圆形，有点像是小鹅卵石。
王叶能量所剩不多，他没有立刻鉴定，而是把石珠拿回去给雷木看。
“你看看是不是这个？”随着他把石珠拿到雷木面前，他脑中也响起了任务完成的提示音，50点经验值到账。
“对。”
“这是什么？”王叶举起石珠看。
雷木摇头，“我也不知道，但应该是好东西，能值点钱。”
雷木想拿这东西还小家伙的照顾之情。他虽然拉了小家伙一把，但后面反而是小家伙照顾他更多，他不喜欢欠人情，能早点还掉最好。
王叶把玩着石珠。
埋在水眼里的水珠，像是石头，但比石头光滑，摸上去水润润的，似乎怎么擦都擦不干。
再回头去看那水眼，就发现里面的水流断了。
王叶根据上辈子的经验推测，想到了一样东西，但是否是他所想的那个东西，还得施展鉴定术看看。
但今晚他要保留一定能量以防万一，就忍住了好奇心。
王叶把石珠又放回到水眼处，特意等了等，大约十分钟后，水眼处再次流出极细的水流。
哪怕没有使用鉴定术，王叶也有了八分把握，这石珠很有可能就是游戏世界天材地宝榜银榜上的“聚水珠”。
聚水珠顾名思义就是把附近的水汽集中生成水流，越是水汽丰富的地方，水流越大。
As the name suggests, water accumulation is to concentrate nearby water vapor to generate a water flow, and the more abundant the water vapor, the greater the water flow.
如果是在沙漠中，聚水珠要花很长时间才能聚集到一点淡水。
If you are in the desert, it will take a long time for the water beads to gather a little fresh water.
倒是在海洋大江大河中，这聚水珠可以当做随船淡水源使用。很多搞船运的大富豪大船长对聚水珠就很渴求。
However, in the great rivers of the ocean, these water beads can be used as a source of fresh water for ships. Many wealthy and captains who are engaged in shipping are very eager to gather water beads.
每次拍卖行有聚水珠出现，都会拍出很不错的价格。 Every time there is a bead of water in the auction house, it will be auctioned at a very good price.
但对大多数人来说，聚水珠只能算是比较鸡肋的宝物。虽然发现不多，但一般人得到都会拿去卖掉，鲜少有自己保留的。
But for most people, the water beads can only be regarded as a relatively trivial treasure. Although there are not many found, most people will sell them when they get them, and few keep them for themselves.
直到他进入游戏第七年，有玩家爆出一个秘密，说如果能找到千年钟乳石液，年份越久越好，把聚水珠养在其中，六十天后聚水珠就能自动变成灵水珠。
It wasn't until he entered the seventh year of the game that a player revealed a secret, saying that if he could find the thousand-year-old stalactite liquid, the longer the year, the better, and if he kept the water beads in it, the water beads would automatically turn into spiritual water beads after sixty days.
再把灵水珠放入任何一个死水中，那死水就会源源不断生出新的水，而且生出的水都是灵水，不但可以饮用，配药效果也极好。
另外这种灵水珠还能用来吸收水源。 In addition, this spiritual water bead can also be used to absorb water.
也只有玩家把游戏当游戏，才会愿意爆出这种消息。要换了游戏世界里的土著，捂着还来不及。
Only if players treat the game as a game will they be willing to break this kind of news. It's too late to change the natives in the game world.

The people of Trench Village have also tried to burn their own pottery, but in the end, they have only wasted a lot of firewood, manpower and time.
王叶耸耸肩：“没烧过，只知道理论，不过这个火窑除了可以烧石灰，也能烧烧砖头和陶器，只要把通风孔改造一下，另外就是烧制的时间不同，烧制物品摆放的位置也不一样，当然烧制方法也不一样。”
Wang Ye shrugged: "I haven't burned it, I only know the theory, but this kiln can not only burn lime, but also burn bricks and pottery, as long as the ventilation holes are transformed, the other thing is that the firing time is different, the position of the firing items is not the same, and of course the firing method is not the same." ”
“那就先用这土火窑烧制一窑石灰，后面就烧制砖头，等砖头烧好了，我们再用砖头加黏土建造一个更大更牢固的火窑。”船锚拍板。
"Then use this clay kiln to burn a kiln of lime, and then burn the bricks, and when the bricks are ready, we will use the bricks and clay to build a bigger and stronger kiln." Anchor clapper.
王叶没意见，反正也不要他出力，他只要动动嘴。
【玩家隔壁小王主动指点海沟村人建造火窑，以及指点火窑的升级方法，提高海沟村人的文明程度，帮助海沟村人脱贫致富，奖励经验值500点。】
【玩家隔壁小王因帮助新手村成长，获得授人以渔成就，奖励经验值200点。】
【扣除已经使用的经验值点数，玩家隔壁小王经验值累积达到2487点，满足升级条件，游戏等级升到二级。】
【恭喜，玩家隔壁小王主动教授海沟村人建造火窑，世界声望值+100，海沟村人对玩家的好感度达到亲密。】
一连四道信息在王叶脑中响起。
王叶嘴都要笑歪了。他的推测没错，果然这才是这个游戏练级的正确方式，上辈子地球玩家全都在喊这个游戏升级太慢，就是因为他们没有掌握正确的升级方法。
这个游戏想要靠杀怪升级，那真的是太慢太慢了。偏偏副本以外的游戏世界，任务的发布率要比一般游戏少得多，而大部分任务都需要玩家自己去寻找和触发。
系统的恭喜声刚落，就见船锚大叔走了过来。
船锚拍了拍王叶的肩膀，对王叶无比亲切地道：“小家伙，大恩不言谢，你对我们村做的这些，你船锚叔和村人都记在心里了。等你身体好了，你要是愿意，叔叔带你去海里打渔。你叔叔别的本事没有，打渔、游泳、操纵船只和在海上辨识方向的本事，还算凑合。”
王叶：看！好感度刷上来了，连教导技艺的师父都主动上门了。
王叶上辈子还没学过怎么操船打渔呢，更不懂怎么在海中辨识方向和求生，听到船锚大叔有传授本领的意思，那哪能不打蛇随棍上？
“要去！要学！船锚叔一定要带上我。”
船锚大笑，揉揉小孩的脑袋，做下决定，只要这孩子想学，他就全都教，保证一点都不藏私。
不过这孩子这么小，又是药师学徒，他学这个好吗？或者教给他大哥雷木也一样？就不知道他大哥对这些渔家把式有没有兴趣了。
雷木当然也愿意多学点，不过这事不急。
火窑建造好，海沟村人就急着想要烧石灰，还是村长看出雷木表情不善，赶紧说两兄弟身上还有伤，忙了一天已经很疲累，让村人不要再缠着两人，让两人回去休息。
回到石洞，海蛋奶奶和儿媳妇一起把石洞重新打扫过了，连晚饭都做好了。
当晚，海蛋和海崖留下来吃晚饭，同时帮着守门，谁让大门还没做好，现在还开了一个窗户洞。
洞内是透气还不暗了，但安全度也大大减低。
海蛋看天还亮着，蛊惑大家一起去海边洗澡，顺便捡点海货入睡前吃。
王叶心动，他不想去赶海，他想去那边的崖洞泡药泥浴。
最后就是海蛋和海崖去洗海浴，王叶和雷木这两个伤患去泡药泥浴。
药泥精华液虽然好，但也不能多服用，王叶打算隔两天服用一次，让药效最大化，这期间则可以用药泥浴来辅佐改善身体状况。
雷木环视整个洞穴，在看到这么多珍贵的海豆芽泥后，心微微一沉，对王叶道：“怀璧其罪，如果让外面人知道这里有这样的好东西，还有这么多，这海沟岛人恐怕没什么好下场。”
好东西总需要强大武力守护，否则那下场都不太好。
王叶没心没肺地挥挥手：“那就不关我们的事了，我告诉他们，他们能否守得住就是他们的事。来来来，你躺到这些海泥里面，只要露出鼻子呼吸就好，躺上至少半小时至多一个小时再出来。衣服都脱了。”
雷木也知道这药泥对他的好处，他身上就一条长裤，这里也没女性，大大方方地脱了，赤身走进洞内深处。
王叶瞅着雷木背影特别想吹口哨，这身材太让人羡慕。雷木的肌肉大多是条形肌，这让他的身体线条看起来特别流畅，那不算细但有清楚人鱼线的腰身不管男女看得都会想要摸一把。
就是身上大小疤痕多了一些，但这没什么，他上辈子也给木头祛过疤，这辈子提前这么多年认识木头，他更能把木头的身体调理得棒棒哒，别说疤痕，就是雷木脸上那些文字刺青，如果雷木不想要，他也能给对方除得干干净净。
不过雷木脸上的文字刺青似乎和他的能力有关，也许不能祛除？
王叶对雷木脸上的刺青文字非常好奇，他问过师父，但师父没说，这辈子也许他可以直接问问雷木？
雷木忽然转头看向洞口。
王叶几乎同时勾了勾手指。
【纠缠不清】发动，无人能看见的因果线悄悄缠住洞口探头探脑的家伙的腿脚。
不管是不是认识的人，只要被他发现，那就产生了因果。
王叶手指一扯。
“哎呀！”对方一声惨叫，脸朝下，摔了个狗吃屎。
这摔的位置也不怎么好，嘴巴正好磕到了石头上。
“谁在外面？”雷木直到这时才发声。
王叶听到有人低声咒骂和爬起来跑掉的声音，那咒骂声听起来无比郁闷，显然没想到自己会突然摔跤。
对方没发现任何不对的地方，只以为自己走路没注意才会绊倒。
王叶打开因果卷，挑起刚才发生的因果线，找到源头，看清人脸和名字，当即冷冷一笑，还是个熟人。
雷木往洞口走，王叶叫住他：“不用去管，来的是那个虾子，大概是想看看我们在干什么。”
雷木以为王叶听出了对方的声音，走到洞口，看到地面有一小摊血。雷木没去追。
“这种人很麻烦。”雷木回来泡到药泥中，慢慢说道。
王叶勾起一个和小孩很不般配的邪恶笑脸：“我最不怕这种人。看他想干什么吧，只要他别后悔。”
正好他还有两个任务和虾子有关，还没完成呢。他没急着去找虾子，就是知道这人会主动把自己送到他面前。
这不就来了？而且虾子这次也许只是打探情况，毕竟村长和船锚等人的动静不小。不过虾子吃了这么一个闷亏，肯定更恨他们，必定会想要报复回来。
回到石洞，王叶把虾子来打探的事跟海崖海蛋兄弟俩说了。
海崖立刻让海蛋留下，他回村去找人。
雷木想让海崖不用这么兴师动众，他已经恢复一些，别说虾子这样的，就是船锚那样的，来十个，他也能揍趴下。
可他看王叶笑眯眯的样子，终究没有多嘴。虾子来找麻烦的事，让海沟村人知道也好。
于是，当晚船锚在入夜前也过来了，还带着村长的大孙子海耀祖。
船锚告诉两人，说村长去找虾子问话，但虾子不肯承认。村长就警告了虾子。
王叶对虾子这种人很熟悉，知道口头警告根本没用，这种人就必须打痛了才知道怕。
撇除海蛋不算，有三个青壮帮两人守夜，当晚王叶和雷木都睡得很熟，至少表面上睡得很熟。
深夜，崖顶除了风声和偶尔小石子被风吹得滚动的声音，就是一片安静。
海耀祖和海崖负责守上半夜，就坐在洞口，点了一个火堆。
两人不是第一次守夜，但这边安全的环境让两人的警惕心大大降低。
他们都不认为虾子还会再过来，船锚带着海耀祖一起过来，只不过是为了表示对王叶和雷木两人的重视。
海耀祖和海崖两人为了不吵到其他人睡觉，也不能彼此说话，只能一个削木枝玩，一个就着火光补家里的渔网。
海耀祖打了个哈气，这玩意有传染性，海崖看他打，忍不住也张嘴打了个。
两人相视无声一笑。
月亮升到中天，海崖的头颅开始一点一点。
海耀祖没推醒他，强打着精神继续削着木箭。
一条黑影赤着脚小心踩在石头上，灵活却缓慢地从石洞后方爬了上来。
海耀祖忽然抬头，看向不远处。
那里似乎有人，他感觉似乎有谁在看他。
海耀祖抓着削尖的木棍站起身，从火堆里抽出一支燃烧的木头，又轻轻踢了踢打瞌睡的海崖。
海崖一惊，身体弹起。
海耀祖手指竖到唇边，指了指他感觉有人的地方，表示要过去看看，让海崖守在原地。
海崖点头，又指了指洞内，意思要不要把洞内的人喊醒。
海耀祖摇摇头，他并没有看到确切的人影，只是有感觉，如果把人喊醒，发现是虚惊一场也不好。
海崖看着海耀祖走向黑暗。
崖顶其实不算非常暗，这里除了大大小小的石洞和石块，并没有其他遮挡物，从天空洒落的月亮和星星的光芒可以让人勉强看清身周三米以内，远处也能隐约看到一些东西。
海崖紧张地盯着海耀祖的方向，完全没有注意到他的身后，石洞上方伸出了一只手。
那只手里提着一个鱼篓。
鱼篓盖子被打开，那只手把鱼篓朝下一倒。
五六条粗细长短不一、白身黑头的蛇被倒出，蛇吐着蛇信，顺着石洞边沿滑向石洞内侧。
“谁在那边，出来！”海耀祖爆喝响起。
海崖立刻冲了过去。
石洞内，雷木和船锚同时睁开眼睛。
王叶身体动了动，感觉到身边熟悉的味道和体温，还感到一双温暖的手掌盖住他的眼睛，他就放心地任由自己坠落梦乡。
海蛋睡得四仰八叉，还打着小呼噜，半点没有醒来的迹象。
“我出去看看。”船锚低声对雷木说道，随后就握住武器起身，向洞外走去。
雷木眼睛微微发亮，他觉得自己听到了什么。
这一刻，雷木把自己的耳力放大。
砰砰的心跳声，呼呼的呼吸声，嘶嘶……这是？！
雷木的眼睛看到了一条……不止一条弯曲游动的能量体。
蛇！
“船锚，别动！你脚边上就有一条蛇。”雷木提醒。
船锚抬起的脚掌凝固住。
王叶的眼睛也啪地睁开。
第24章 飘嘛飘
“等着，等它离开。”
雷木起身，蓄势待发。在一条蛇快要游到海蛋身边时，他猛地探身，一把抓住蛇尾，再用力一甩，甩的那条蛇无法回转蛇头咬他，再抓紧蛇尾朝地上猛力一砸。
蛇被砸死。
雷木伸手又去抓第二条蛇，同时告知船锚可以把脚掌放下，并让他向洞外跑。
那几条蛇全都游向了洞内。
“小叶子，海蛋，醒醒。有蛇！至少还有五条。”雷木喊，顺手抓起放在一边的木棍。
“醒了。不用管我。”王叶后悔没在洞内也点一个火堆，搞得现在两眼摸黑，什么都看不见。
而那些游进洞的蛇也没有谁主观上想要咬他，这导致他无法料敌先制。
王叶不解，他在洞里撒了防蛇虫的药，为什么还有蛇游进来？
“海蛋！”王叶捏住小孩鼻子，又用力推搡，小孩子最难叫起来了。
海蛋终于醒来，可醒来后仍旧迷迷糊糊，被王叶连喊了几声有毒蛇，才嗷的一嗓子叫出来，彻底清醒了。
“出去，到洞外，不要留在洞内。海蛋往左边两步，直行跑出去。小叶子你往右边过来三步，然后别动。”雷木厉喝。
海蛋也遇到过毒蛇，听到吩咐，很听话地就照样做了。
王叶握住木棍，往雷木靠近。
幸好船锚经验丰富，冲向洞口，又拿着几支火把冲了进来。
洞内一下变得明亮不少。
“白身黑头，这是黑头蛇！”船锚声音满含怒意和些微惊慌，他不怕蛇，但那只限于身边只有一两条蛇，可现在洞里却有五六条蛇。而且洞里那么暗，蛇躲在暗处，根本防不胜防。
“毒蛇？”王叶确认。
“对。这是岛上一种常见毒蛇，毒得很，被咬到如果半天内不能服下解药，之后再服下解药也没用。大家先出去，不要留在里面。”船锚的建议和雷木一模一样。
船锚还把两支火把分给王叶和雷木，让他们弯着腰在脚边挥舞，这样可以让蛇避开。
“洞里撒了驱蛇药。”王叶道。
船锚一边小心地上游走的毒蛇，一边摇头：“驱蛇药也不是绝对，我们村就有不少人家在家里撒了蛇药，但还是会有蛇溜进来，有运气不好的还有被咬的。”
“是吗。”王叶总觉得有点不对劲，忽然问：“虾子和他哥鲨鱼会抓蛇吗？”
船锚一愣：“岛上毒蛇不少，大家基本都会一手抓蛇的本领，只不过有人强有人弱。你怀疑是虾子放的蛇？”
船锚不等王叶回答，就摇头道：“不可能。那小子虽然不干好事，但我们都还在这里，他没这个胆子。”
“如果不是人为，怎么可能在撒了蛇药的情况下一下子游进来五六条毒蛇？是不是虾子，查查就知道。”王叶冷声道。
船锚还以为王叶是让他们回村里查，答应道：“好，等明天回村我就查查虾子晚上是否在家。”
王叶有了照明就有了用武之地，看准一条毒蛇，施展【冤冤相报】，力气变大，木棍头飞快向蛇头下方打去。
黑头蛇七寸被打中。
打蛇捉蛇就要胆子大，只要胆子大、看得准、动作快，毒蛇并不比其他野兽可怕到哪里。
王叶用脚踩住木棍，抄起一块石头就砸向蛇脑袋。
黑头蛇的脑袋被砸得稀烂。
王叶丢下石头，打开别人看不见的因果卷，挑起刚刚缠到他身上的因果线。
顺着这条因果线找到那条蛇，再从那条蛇身上的因果线找到释放蛇的人……如果有这个人的话。
因果卷告诉他，就是有这个人，还就是船锚口中认为没这个胆子的虾子。
船锚可不知道王叶有因果卷在手，凡是想害他的人再怎么躲都没用。
上辈子，就有人表面和王叶称兄道弟，暗地里则为了利益谋害他，可对方往往还没把阴谋彻底完成就发现自己栽了。这些人到死都搞不清楚王叶是怎么知道他们在害他。
王叶很生气，不是因为虾子敢用毒蛇来害他们，而是生气自己的自大和轻敌。
虽然雷木提前发现了毒蛇，他也有因果卷能知道是谁在背后谋害他们。
但如果他和雷木的伤势都还没有好，今晚也没有这么多人守夜，最后会发生什么事，谁能确定？
他怎么敢就睡得那么熟？怎么敢全部依赖别人？而且除了防守的人，他怎么敢其他什么准备都没做，就撒一点蛇药和防蚊虫的药？
“啪！”王叶狠狠甩了自己一个耳光。
这是他重生以来打自己的第二个耳光。
重生后，就算没说出来，但他的潜意识难免抱了几分“自己是天选之子”的骄傲和得意。
都能重生了，不是天选之子又是什么？
飘飘然，有。欣喜若狂，有。自得，有。
而他上辈子什么时候敢这样骄傲自大过？他哪怕成了别人口中的大佬，面对一个小混混都不敢大意，因为他自己就是从小混混爬上来的，最知道这种人能干出什么事。
他从不小瞧任何人，哪怕对方是婴儿、是老人、是病弱残疾。
可重生后呢？
他可以不把自己伪装成一个真正的小孩，毕竟早熟早慧的孩子多得是，但他也不能真把自己当做老天爷的亲儿子。
否则他这辈子指不定能死得比上辈子还早。
他死了没关系，要是再次拖累木头和师父，还有姑姑怎么办？
雷木和船锚都吓了一跳。
雷木怒，一把抓住他的手：“你好好地打自己干什么？”

Not to mention that lime has many other benefits, such as insecticidal and detoxification, treatment of scabies, sores and rot, etc. On the building, you can brush the wall to whiten and remove moisture and prevent insects, and mix with soil to make a foundation. In farming, it can be used to kill insects, use as fertilizer, and keep plants warm from the cold. Even when it is used as food, it is also useful, clear lime water can make pectin foods coagulate, and it can also remove some food toxicity.
而贝壳烧出来的石灰可以直接使用在食物中。 The lime from the shells can be used directly in food.

Grandpa Hai Dan spread this word among the villagers that day, so that the villagers knew that he was generous to foreign brothers. It also made some people who feel that the shrimp and sharks are too ruthless to come to their senses, yes, of course, the shrimp has to pay for the harm of people, and the harm is their own people, what does it have to do with the two guests?
而鲨鱼……如果不是他包庇，虾子又怎么可能胆子越来越大，之后更发展到用毒蛇来害人的程度？
And the shark ...... If it weren't for him to cover up, how could the shrimp have become more and more bold, and then it has developed to the extent of using poisonous snakes to harm people?
村人想明白了，对王叶和雷木两人没有了任何意见，反而越发尊重这两个只会给村子送好处，却不会掺和村内事的外人。
The villagers figured it out, and they no longer had any opinions on Wang Ye and Lei Mu, but instead respected these two outsiders who would only bring benefits to the village, but would not get involved in the affairs of the village.
而村人对两人尊重的体现，就是给他们送东西，来帮他们修建改造石洞。
And the embodiment of the villagers' respect for the two is to send them things to help them build and renovate the stone cave.
在众人齐心合力的努力下，石洞很快就改造完毕，能真正入住了。
With the concerted efforts of everyone, the stone cave was quickly renovated and can be truly occupied.
石洞朝南的洞壁多了一个长宽约一米左右的方形窗洞，窗洞上安装了可以推开的木窗，还挂了一个棕榈叶帘子。白天打开，通风又敞亮。
There is a square window hole about one meter long and wide on the south-facing wall of the cave, and a wooden window that can be pushed open is installed on the window opening, and a palm leaf curtain is hung. Open during the day, it is ventilated and bright.
水池那边多了一个朝外的排水沟和排水孔，可以让脏水顺着排水沟流出洞外。另外还弄了大小两个水池，大水池可以洗澡，小水池用来冲洗东西。
There is an outward-facing drain and drain hole on the side of the pool, which allows dirty water to flow down the drain out of the hole. In addition, there are two pools, large and small, the large pool for bathing and the small pool for rinsing things.
灶台也砌上了，不过不是王叶认为的常见老式灶台，而是用石头垒建起来的火塘。石头下方是空心，可以放木柴进入烧火，石头上面可以架锅，也可以架烤架。
The stove was also built, but it was not the common old-fashioned stove that Wang Ye thought, but a fire pit built with stones. Underneath the stone is a hollow where firewood can be placed to enter the fire, and a pot or grill can be set up on top of the stone.
最让王叶满意的是，石洞里多了一张床。 What satisfied Wang Ye the most was that there was an extra bed in the stone cave.
虽然是一块被人合力抬进来的平整大石头，但那石头又宽又大，足够两米宽两米五长，表面也十分平整光滑，铺上席子就能当床睡，除了硬了点、凉了点，也没其他缺点了。
Although it is a large flat stone that has been carried in by a joint force, the stone is wide and large, enough to be two meters wide and two meters and five meters long, and the surface is also very smooth and smooth, and it can be used as a bed to sleep on a mat, except for being a little harder and cooler, there are no other shortcomings.
为了把这块石头抬进来，原本不大的石洞口被扩大了许多。
In order to bring this stone in, the entrance to the originally small stone cave was enlarged a lot.
石洞口被凿成了长方形，镶上了门板，还做了门槛。门头上也挂了一张卷起来的棕榈叶帘子。
The entrance to the stone cave was hewn into a rectangle, with panels and thresholds. A rolled-up palm leaf curtain also hung over the door.
石洞内部整体被石灰刷白，比之前亮堂许多，也不再那么潮湿。
The interior of the cave is whitewashed with lime, which is much brighter than before, and it is no longer so damp.
墙边搁了好几个木架子，还有几个草编的箱笼和簸箩。 There were several wooden shelves on the wall, as well as a few straw cages and dustpans.
墙上挂了几个篮子和鱼篓，还有一张新渔网。这渔网可是村里人的骄傲，他们海沟村用的渔网是附近几个海岛最结实的，能网大鱼不会轻易破。
Several baskets and baskets were hung on the wall, as well as a new fishing net. This fishing net is the pride of the villagers, and the fishing net used in their trench village is the strongest among the nearby islands, and it will not be easily broken by big fish.
这种渔网用的是海沟岛特产的一种麻，泡出来的纤维韧性非常。但这种韧麻不多，海沟村人对这种韧麻的使用都非常珍惜。
This kind of fishing net is made of a kind of hemp, which is a specialty of Trench Island, and the fiber is very tough. But there are not many of these tenacities, and the people of Trench Village cherish the use of them.
火塘旁边还放了一个很大的木桌和四张木凳。木桌很厚实，长度有两米多，能当案板和台面使用。
There was also a large wooden table and four wooden benches next to the firepit. The wooden table is thick, more than two meters long, and can be used as a board and countertop.
王叶要的灶台因为比较大，村人也没做过，几番尝试后被搭建在外面，上面还盖了一个遮灰挡雨的棕榈棚。
Because the stove that Wang Ye wanted was relatively large, the villagers had never done it, so after several attempts, it was built outside, and a palm shed was also built on top to cover the dust and rain.
这个灶台的完工，还让王叶又拿到了五十点经验值。而海沟村人有几户条件还可以的人家，都在请海蛋爷爷帮忙把火塘改成两眼的灶台。
The completion of this stove also allowed Wang Ye to get another fifty experience points. And there are several families in Haigou Village who are in good condition, and they are asking Grandpa Haidan to help change the fire pit into a two-eye stove.
棕榈棚比较大，里面另外又放了一套全天然无修饰的石头座椅板凳。平时有客人来，都可以待在这里，不用进出石洞。
海蛋爷爷还给王叶他们建造了一个简易厕所，同样是棕榈棚，里面用石头垫高，中间挖个很深的洞。
海蛋爷爷说等这个洞满了，就把这个埋了，在旁边再挖一个洞，方便得很。
Grandpa Haidan said that when this hole was full, he would bury this and dig another hole next to it, which was very convenient.
王叶：“……”也没什么好求的了，入乡随俗吧。 Wang Ye: "......" is nothing to ask for, let's follow the customs.
第25章 鲨鱼、石膏和神秘人
鲨鱼转头看向身后的岛屿，他要离开了，他的家乡。
没有人来送他们，这也是意料之中。
“来，给村子磕头。”鲨鱼招呼自己的长子，自己率先跪下。
鲨鱼的长子才五岁，小家伙个头很结实，和他父亲很像，见他父亲跪下，他也跪下了。小小的孩子还不知道家里发生了什么事，只知道他们要离开村子到别的地方生活。
鲨鱼的妻子，一个很文静的女人，抱着才一岁的幼女，同样在丈夫身边跪下。
一家四口对着岛屿村落的方向磕了三个头。
鲨鱼把妻子扶起来，扶她上了村里给的小船。
船只都是村里的共同财产，他能拿到这艘小船，除了是村里的人情，他还付出了家中所有铜币和他们新建好没多久的房子。也只有这样，才能堵上村里某些人的嘴巴——他们兄弟欠村里太多。
这是一艘能坐得下四个成年人的小船，鲨鱼妻子抱着幼女和长子坐在丈夫的对面。
鲨鱼先把家里的重要财产都放到船中，四个里面塞满了东西的鱼篓。
最后，鲨鱼推着渔船走入海里，等到海水超过他腰部，他才爬上船，拿起船桨用力划动。
鲨鱼的妻子眼看船只离海沟岛越来越远，眼圈红了。
“对不起。”鲨鱼忽然沉闷道。
鲨鱼妻子摇摇头，擦掉要落下的眼泪：“不怪你。”
“怪我。要不是我，虾子不会有那么大胆子，是我纵容了他，也……忽视了你们。”鲨鱼看着妻子，突然发现他已经很久没有仔细看过他的妻子。
文静的女人再次摇头：“别说了，我相信你，就算离开村子，只要有你在，我们去了其他地方一样能活得好。”
尤其在他们甩开虾子后。
鲨鱼看着妻子，心中感动非常。妻子的鼓励和信任，对此时的他异常重要。
文静的女人对丈夫露出安抚的淡笑。
女人从来不在丈夫面前说小叔子的坏话，但她心里也对虾子厌烦得不得了。虾子有什么事都来找她丈夫，看到她家有什么好东西，随手就拿了，就连孩子的食物和布料，他都能拿。
丈夫很能干，每年都去海草村赶集，每年也都能换到一些铜钱甚至是银币，可这些钱大半都被虾子拿走了。
丈夫总是说虾子还小，又是他唯一的弟弟，父母走前让他一定要好好照顾这个弟弟，说等虾子再大一些就懂事了。
可虾子直到死，也没有真正懂事，而他死的时候已经二十二岁。
不，虾子不是不懂事，他只是根子就是歪的，怎么掰也长不好，何况她丈夫也没怎么掰过。
虾子死了，女人是真的松了口气，哪怕听说要离开村子，她也没有感到沮丧。
鲨鱼才五岁的长子忽然道：“爹，虾子叔叔会跟着我们一起走吗？”
鲨鱼心中一痛：“不会了，他会永远留在岛上。”
鲨鱼长子吁了口气，满脸轻松地说：“太好了。”
说完，小家伙就有点害怕地看向父亲，依偎向母亲。
鲨鱼心中苦涩无比：“别怕，父亲以前糊涂了，以后不会了，以后爹会好好照顾你们。”也会好好教导两个孩子，不让他们长歪了。
小家伙依偎着母亲露出天真的笑颜，真心实意地道：“虾子叔叔死了真好。”
小孩子对于死亡的理解还很模糊，他只隐约知道虾子叔叔死了，死了就不能跟着他们，但他又不确定，今天听父亲亲口说了才真正放心。
鲨鱼看到长子那开心的笑脸，心里苦涩更重，他以前都做了什么？他为什么要护着就连妻子和儿子都讨厌的虾子，就因为他会拍马屁会哄他吗？
虾子害的那些人，他也是凶手。所以他亲手淹死了虾子，从此他将背负杀弟之罪，这也是他应得的惩罚。
鲨鱼看到妻儿对未来的期盼，听着长子对海草村的好奇提问，也更庆幸自己的决定。
他原本可以不离开村子，但为了两个孩子，他必须离开。
他不希望两个孩子将来被人指指戳戳，就因为他们有个害人的叔叔，还有个作为帮凶的父亲。
他和妻子互视，彼此都明白他们以后再也不会提起虾子，也不会提起他们在海沟村的过去，他们要让孩子们清清白白地长大，村里给了他们重新开始的机会，他们要珍惜这个机会。
啪，一只手抓住了船舷。
一颗头从海水里冒出。
这一幕有点吓人。
鲨鱼妻子发出一声轻微的惊叫，两个孩子没有吓到，反而好奇地看向水里的人。
鲨鱼立刻持起船桨就要打向那只手。
“别动手！我没有恶意。”抓住船舷的人恳求道：“我只是想要跟你们的船一起去海草岛。”
“你是谁？”鲨鱼从没有见过这个人。
这是个很瘦的男人，肤色苍白，大约三十岁左右，抓着船舷的手缺了一根手指。
缺指男道：“你们不用管我是谁，只要你们肯带我一起去海草岛，我会报答你们。”
鲨鱼警惕地道：“我们不需要你的报答，我们的船很小，挤不下了。”
鲨鱼不是多仁慈的人，船上不止他一人，还有他的妻儿，他两个孩子都那么小，他不打算冒险。
缺指男可能也猜到鲨鱼不会这么简单就让他上船，喘口气说道：“你当你们村为什么同意让你离开，还让你尽快离开？”
鲨鱼冷下脸：“你想说什么？”
缺指男抹了抹脸上的海水：“我知道你们村一个秘密，这个秘密关系到很大一笔财产。只要你把我送到海草岛，我就把这个秘密告诉你。”
鲨鱼眼神闪烁：“什么秘密？”
鲨鱼妻子皱起眉头，担心地看向丈夫。她宁可丈夫不要去听这个秘密。
“我可以告诉你，你唯一的弟弟被杀，你们村还把你们一家驱逐，真实原因并不只是因为你弟用毒蛇害人，而是他们不想让你们知道那个能赚很多钱的秘密。”
鲨鱼沉默。
鲨鱼妻子急了，开口：“他爹！”
缺指男看出鲨鱼眼中闪过痛苦之色，加重语气道：“是什么秘密我可以告诉你，你们村发现了非常珍贵的药物，量很大，药效也极好。这些药物卖出去可以卖出天价。但你们村长还有少数几个人，不想把这个好处分给别人，你和虾子都是不稳定因素，他们早就想解决你们，正好虾子犯事，就给了他们很好地解决你们兄弟的借口。”
鲨鱼妻子看缺指男的目光满是愤恨。这个人明显在挑拨离间，而她丈夫……
鲨鱼低声说道：“你把这些告诉我，就是想让我送你去海草岛？”
缺指男点头：“没错，只要你能把我安全送到海草岛，我就把那些药物的详细地点告诉你。到时候你只要找到对这种药物感兴趣的人，带他们去海沟岛，你不但可以获得大笔利益，还能把村子的管理权给抢过来，以后海沟村人都要看你的脸色过日子，你和你的妻子孩子也不用颠沛流离去陌生地方讨生活。”
鲨鱼妻子忍不住了，叫道：“你闭嘴！村里的事我们一家不想掺和。他爹，赶这个人下海！”
鲨鱼抬手，示意妻子安静，放下船桨，抓住那人的手腕，问：“你会甘心把这个秘密告诉我，让我去赚这个好处？”
感觉到鲨鱼上钩，缺指男差点笑出来，忙道：“我只想离开海沟岛去海草岛，海沟岛那些药物对你们来说很值钱，但我不缺那点钱。”
“你是那座囚犯岛逃出来的囚犯？”鲨鱼突然问。
缺指男否认：“当然不是。”
鲨鱼盯着缺指男，点点头，“希望你说话算数，我现在就拉你上来。”
除了他们村，就是海草岛的人也不知道海沟岛隔壁是一座囚犯岛，但这个人明显知道。
缺指男道谢。
鲨鱼手上用力把缺指男往上提。
缺指男借力，另一只手也抓住船舷，两只手一起用力往船中爬。
鲨鱼松手，快速抓起放在腿边的船桨，用力挥向缺指男的头颅。
砰！缺指男没想到鲨鱼会突然动手，他尽量闪避，但还是被击中肩膀。
缺指男痛呼一声，感到肩膀骨可能碎了。
鲨鱼再次挥起船桨。
“为什么？”缺指男怒吼，痛恨地怒瞪鲨鱼。
鲨鱼冷笑：“你以为我是我弟，被你说两句就心动？敢打我们村的主意，去死吧！”
他正不知道该怎么弥补曾经犯下的过错，这个人来得正好。
缺指男看出鲨鱼的杀心，后悔自己看错人，不得不放弃爬进船只，松开手，落入海中。
鲨鱼放下船桨，对妻子快速交代：“等我！那人对村子不怀好意，不能放他离开。”
说完，鲨鱼就跳入水中。
鲨鱼妻子焦急地把幼女交给长子，扒到船舷去看丈夫，过一会儿又抓过船桨，打算那个缺指男一冒头就打下去。
但她只见到水面翻腾，半会儿都不见有人冒头。
鲨鱼妻子越等越急，如果不是船里还有两个年龄幼小的孩子在，她就跳进海水里去帮丈夫了。
过了大约三四分钟，健壮的上半身从海水里钻出。
鲨鱼妻子看到丈夫还活着，喜极而泣，忙伸出船桨。
鲨鱼游向小船，抓住船桨靠近船只，再抓住船舷，翻身爬进船舱。
“你受伤了！那个人怎样？”鲨鱼妻子连声问，又赶紧打开鱼篓寻找止血药。
鲨鱼脸色有些苍白，身上还有不少伤痕，靠近胸口的位置还被什么尖锐的东西戳出一个小洞，但里面没有血流出。
“爹。”鲨鱼长子扶着妹妹，焦急又担心地喊。
鲨鱼过了好一会儿才开口道：“没事了。那人已经死了，村子安全了，我们走。”
鲨鱼妻子拿出伤药给丈夫敷上，问：“不用回村说一声吗？”
鲨鱼缓慢摇头：“不用。”
海水下方，一具男尸面朝下漂浮着，他的背部正中心破了一个拳头大的洞，更诡异的是他的尸体就好像被人吸干了体液，变得又瘪又皱。
王叶站在崖顶，摸摸下巴，眼中露出一丝疑惑，见小船远去，这才溜溜达达地回到石洞口。
雷木正躺在当做厨房用的棕榈棚里，别人只当他在睡觉，实际他是在运功疗养受伤的筋脉。
“鲨鱼走了。”王叶道。
雷木眼都不睁地道：“哦。”
王叶嘴角有一丝玩味的笑：“我看到有个人想爬上他的船，但被鲨鱼用船桨打下去，之后鲨鱼还跳到海水里，好像是在和那人搏斗。”
雷木微微睁开眼睛：“谁？虾子？”
王叶摇头：“不是。虾子已经死了。”
在游戏系统告诉他完成那两个任务的同时，他就收到了一份因果之力，他看了因果卷，虾子和他之间的因果消失，虾子这个人也已经从这个世界彻底消亡。
“鲨鱼赢了？”
“嗯。”

村长倒不介意孙子入赘，但耀祖明显对做草药师没兴趣，而多美那丫头看着也不像是想要和耀祖在一起。

雷木看得好笑。

村长大喜，脸上因为鲨鱼和寄生虫导致的愁容都消散不少，连声说好，又不住跟两兄弟道谢。

到了船锚家，船锚把家人很郑重地介绍给王叶和雷木，又把家人都赶开，不准他们围观。

只有因果之力，可以把被杀死的寄生虫尸体直接转变为养料，用来滋养被寄生体，也算是偿还寄生的因果。
所以王叶敢在被寄生者的身体内直接动手杀虫，而不用担心虫体残渣留在被寄生者体内伤害到被寄生体。

但二级母虫幼虫可不像是一级的血吸虫雄虫幼虫那么弱，能乖乖被他束缚住，最后无可奈何被他杀死再转变成养料。
他现在是三级，二级母虫就算刚刚孵化，那也相当于玩家十五级左右。

最麻烦的是他在和虫子搏斗时，还得困住虫子不让它乱跑，否则被寄生体就要遭受大罪，搞不好疼死都有可能。
如果虫子被他逼急了，从被寄生体内逃跑，就会强行撕裂被寄生者的身体，就像那怪物一样。

无他，因为雷木恢复了。
他在之前输送能量时就察觉那只虫子被困在瘸腿男的心脏部位，一动不能动。

上辈子他帮别人除虫，就是木头用这招帮他固定住虫子。
好吧，不止是虫子，还有其他想要对付他、和他想要对付的家伙。

“你是谁？你在做什么？放开我！”瘸腿男惊恐大叫。

表面上看，王叶似乎不为所动，一心除虫。但在别人看不到的精神层面，他正在抵御那只二级母虫的精神攻击和感染。
上辈子他就曾想过，《极度危险》这个游戏每次给玩家升级，都会给玩家增加一定的精神力值，也许就是为了抵抗寄生虫族。

一旦遇到寄生虫族的精神攻击，玩家抵抗不了，游戏系统会在危险值前立刻宣布玩家的“死亡”，让他们脱离游戏。
如此，玩家损失的只是游戏赋予的身体，他们的精神力源绝不会受到无法修复性的伤害。而他们在游戏中做任务升级的过程，其实就是在锻炼自己的精神力。
当玩家们的精神力达到一定程度，就能抵抗寄生虫族的精神力攻击，甚而反过来杀死寄生虫族。
他嘛，现在只有三级，如果按照普通地球玩家的普遍精神力值计算，他现在根本无法抵御二级母虫的精神攻击，但大约是重生归来的缘故，他的初始精神力值就很高。
何况他还清楚一点别人不知道的小秘密，别看对抗寄生虫族的精神力攻击很痛苦，但如果能熬过去，对自己的精神力增长会有莫大好处。
而且不知道是因果之力的效用，还是他的精神力原本就有一点特殊，他发现他似乎可以吞噬和消化别的精神力为自己所用。
如果是更高级的寄生虫族攻击他，也许会有点麻烦，但对面那只二级八脚线母虫的精神力值貌似比他还低一些，用精神力攻击他，几乎是在给他送菜，正中他的下怀。
第31章 魔偶和石片
这只二级八脚线母虫大约也没想到就在它刚刚孵化，即将改造这具身体，开始大展拳脚之前，竟然会遇到雷木和王叶这两个奇葩。
这两人，一人能困住它，不让它逃跑。
另一人则能不断抽取它身体内的能量。
当它把希望全部寄托在精神力攻击上时，却发现它的精神力全都有去无回。
虫子慌了，向周边发出求救信号，希望周边有寄生虫族能来帮助它。
但没有。
它明明应该还有一个同伴，对方比它提前孵化，虽然它寄生的那具身体死了，但它应该立刻就选择了另一具寄生体。
而那具已经死亡的前寄生体也不会被浪费，它们是母虫，从孵化开始就会产卵，只要当时情况和时间允许，那只母虫在脱离前寄生体时，一定会产下大量虫卵。
这些都是雄虫的虫卵只要孵化，它们就会到处吸食养料，再飞回母虫身边，反哺母虫。
虽然它不是那些雄虫的母虫，但它是二级，那些雄虫只是一级，听到它的召唤，也必定会过来救它。可为什么一只都没有出现？
难道那只母虫已经远离这座岛屿？包括它产下的虫卵也是？
二级八脚线母虫感到生命消逝，它开始向那个人类幼崽传递求饶信息，表示自己可以臣服他，为他做事。
但没有用，那个人类小崽铁了心要杀死它，它就要支撑不住。
它、它的身体也在融化，这是什么古怪的力量？

第33章 彩色珍珠

这种海菜在海岛最不值钱，基本上都是作为搭头送人。
王叶瞅着这些海菜，忽然叹了口气。
雷木正奇怪王叶怎么买那么多看起来不太好吃的海肠，见他对海菜叹气，就问：“怎么了，不喜欢吃海菜？”
“不是，是我知道一个秘密，特别想说出来，憋死我了。”
雷木喷笑，拍拍小孩的脑袋，“跟海菜有关？”
王叶点头，忍不住道：“等回去我跟你说。”
路上人多眼杂，雷木提着篓子和海菜没有立刻收入空间，反正这点重量对他而言根本不算什么。
“你喜欢吃这种海肠？”雷木好奇地问。
王叶点头又摇头：“海肠味道确实不错，不过我买这么多不是买来当食物吃，而是打算拿它们当做调味料。”
海肠皮晒干磨成的粉可是不亚于味精的调味料，加到任何菜肴里都会增加其口感，比蘑菇粉还提鲜。
王叶舌头吃惯了味精鸡精，总觉得没加味精的菜肴吃起来没滋没味，如今看到海肠哪会放过。
雷木失笑，他早就发现王叶的嘴巴有点馋，看到好吃的就走不动路，而且别看他小，厨艺竟然意外得不错。
这又是王叶怪异的一点，小小年纪却懂得比成年人还多。如果只是拥有知识也就罢了，但这孩子明显还有大量的动手经验，这就很古怪了。
王叶嘴馋那是有历史原因的，他上辈子在干掉老王之前能吃饱就不错，想要吃得好那是不可能的。小孩子看着别的孩子想吃什么吃什么，能不嘴馋吗？
但又买不起。一直到他后来混社会，手上有了点小钱，才开始买那些过去买不起的食物吃，但想吃更好更贵的也不可能。就这么一路馋到了在游戏中变成大佬，结果还没吃两年好东西，就被围杀了。
他现在对雷木好，喜欢吃美食，其实都是出于一种对自我的补偿心理。
他心里明白这点，但也不想做出改变。也许日后，他这种补偿心理会在精神得到满足后慢慢消失，但现在他并不想克制，他就怕自己一克制，更憋出心病来。
“木木，我们去那边！”王叶看到了好东西。
他竟然看到有人在卖蟒皮。
他这次来集市就是想买一些能制作因果武器的材料，蟒皮正是他需要的最重要的材料。
原本他还想着如果在集市买不到这东西，他就请雷木和他一起进山看看。
卖蟒皮的摊主是今天刚赶到的，别人都开始卖货了，他们这儿才开始把货物摆出来。
像这样没有来得及在开集日赶来的商贩特别多，后面陆陆续续也会来人，毕竟集市有一个月。
这家摊子上卖的蟒皮非常完整，而且有好几条，有大有小。
王叶拿着蟒皮翻来覆去地看。
除了他，也有别人注意到这家的货物。
这家摊子不止卖蟒皮，还卖一些兽类的皮毛和罕见的鸟类羽毛，包括一些野兽身上的爪牙等零碎。
“这张蟒皮怎么卖？”王叶的声音和另一人的声音同时响起。
"How do you sell this python skin?" Wang Ye's voice and the other person's voice sounded at the same time.
那人的手也抓着蟒皮的另一部分。 The man's hand also grasped the other part of the python's skin.
王叶不爽，这蟒皮是他先拿到手里的，只是比较长，才没有全拢到面前。
Wang Ye was unhappy, this python skin was the first thing he got in his hand, but it was relatively long, so he didn't put it all in front of him.
摊主看王叶是个小孩，就没怎么在意，面对另外一个客人，回答道：“这是黑皮蟒，能吃人的那种，这蟒长得大，我们废了两个大小伙子才捕到。”
The stall owner didn't pay much attention to Wang Ye when he saw that he was a child, and when he faced another guest, he replied: "This is a black-skinned python, the kind that can eat people, this python grows big, and we scrapped two young men to catch it." ”
那客人不耐烦地打断摊主：“我问你价格，又没问你这蟒皮是怎么来的。”
The customer impatiently interrupted the stall owner: "I asked you the price, but I didn't ask you where this python skin came from." ”
摊主收口，他说这么多也只是希望能报个高价，见客人不高兴，他也不敢再多说，报了个自认为很实惠的价格：“我们还没开张，如果客人诚心想买，这张黑皮蟒的蟒皮就算您一金五十银币。”
The stall owner closed his mouth, he said so much just to hope to quote a high price, seeing that the guests were unhappy, he didn't dare to say more, and quoted a price that he thought was very affordable: "We haven't opened yet, if the guests sincerely want to buy, this python skin of the black python will cost you a gold and fifty silver coins." ”
“一金五十银？太贵了，你宰人呢。八十银币，这蟒皮我要了。”说着，这客人就要把蟒皮卷起来。
"One gold and fifty silver? It's too expensive, you slaughter people. Eighty silver coins, I want this python skin. As he spoke, the guest was going to roll up the python skin.
王叶忍到现在，终于忍不住：“你懂不懂什么叫先来后到？而且人摊主还没答应卖给你，你收个屁货！一金五十银是吗，哥，付钱。”
Wang Ye endured until now, and finally couldn't help it: "Do you know what it means to come first and then come?" And the stall owner hasn't promised to sell it to you, you take a piece of! One gold and fifty silver, brother, pay. ”
雷木二话不说，掏出一金五十银币递给卖家。 Lei Mu didn't say a word, took out a gold and fifty silver coins and handed it to the seller.
卖家一看头一笔生意这么快就做成，高兴地接过钱币：“多谢惠顾，这蟒皮归两位了。”
When the seller saw that the first business was completed so quickly, he happily took the coin: "Thank you for your patronage, this python skin belongs to the two." ”
卖家又忍不住道：“我说真心话，我这价开的真不高。这蟒皮特别结实，刀子都不能轻易划破，就是做皮甲都行。我们也就是有特殊的处理方法，才能把皮子剖得这么好。对了，你们篓子里有地方装吗？没有，我给你们找个筐子装起来。”
The seller couldn't help but say: "I'll tell you the truth, my price is really not high." This python skin is particularly strong, and it can't be easily cut by a knife, even if it is made of leather armor. We also have a special treatment method to cut the skin so well. By the way, do you have a place in your basket? No, I'll find you a basket to put on. ”
“好的，给我一个筐。”王叶用力要把蟒皮拽过来。 "Okay, give me a basket." Wang Ye tried hard to pull the python skin over.
可那客人竟然不肯放，还很生气地道：“是我先问的价格，我之前报价八十银币，摊主也没说不同意。凭什么你出价高，现在就要给你？摊主你做生意太不地道！”
But the guest refused to let it go, and said angrily: "It's the price I asked first, I quoted eighty silver coins before, and the stall owner didn't say he didn't agree." Why are you bidding so high that you are going to give it to you now? Stallholder, your business is too unauthentic! ”
摊主气，当即就和那客人吵起来：“我们做生意怎么不地道了？我卖价一金五十银币的蟒皮，你张口就还到八十银，我们压根就没答应。现在别人钱都付了，你在这耍什么赖皮，当我们蛇岛的人好欺负是不是？”
The stall owner was angry, and immediately quarreled with the customer: "Why aren't we doing business authentic?" I sold a python skin for one gold and fifty silver coins, and you opened your mouth to return it to eighty silver, and we didn't agree at all. Now that everyone else has paid for it, what are you doing here, when the people of Snake Island are easy to bully, aren't they? ”
正在忙碌的蛇岛人闻声全都看向这边，还有几个身体特别健壮的从棕榈屋里走出来。
The people of Snake Island, who were busy, all looked at this side when they heard the sound, and a few particularly sturdy people came out of the palm house.
那客人气得脸色爆红，用力摔下蟒皮，指着蛇岛人的鼻子就放狠话：“行，我记住你们了。”
The guest's face turned red with anger, and he threw off the python skin hard, pointed at the nose of the snake island man and said cruelly: "Okay, I remember you." ”
那客人又伸手一指王叶和雷木，“敢跟我抢东西，你们等着！”
The guest stretched out his hand and pointed at Wang Ye and Lei Mu again, "Dare to grab something from me, you wait!" ”
王叶轻哼：哪来的傻叉。 Wang Ye snorted lightly: Where did you get the stupid fork?
雷木上前一步，一把握住那客人的手指，轻轻一掰。 Lei Mu stepped forward, grabbed the guest's finger, and gently broke it.
“啊啊啊！”客人发出惨叫：“我的手指！松开，快松开！”
"Ahhh The guest screamed: "My finger! Loosen up, let go quickly! ”
雷木神色平淡地道：“没有人教过你不要随便用手指指人吗？”
Lei Mu said with a flat expression: "Didn't anyone teach you not to point your finger at people casually?" ”
那客人不住喊痛，路人开始停下脚步围观。 The guest couldn't stop crying out in pain, and passers-by began to stop and watch.
雷木看那人确实痛得受不了了，这才松开手掌。他没有掰断这人的手指，只是给了他一点小小教训。
Lei Mu saw that the man was really in pain and couldn't stand it, so he let go of his palm. He didn't break the man's fingers, he just taught him a small lesson.
“你们给我等着！”那客人这次不敢再用手指指人，握着差点被掰断的手指，又羞又恼，气愤无比地钻入人群。
"You're waiting for me!" This time, the guest did not dare to point his finger at the person again, holding the finger that was almost broken, ashamed and annoyed, and burrowed into the crowd in great anger.
“大兄弟，那人看着似乎有点身份地位，你们小心一点。”摊主提醒雷木。
"Big brother, that person seems to have a bit of status, you should be careful." The stall owner reminded Lei Mu.
雷木对其颔首：“谢谢，你们也是。” Lei Mu bowed to his chin: "Thank you, you too." ”
摊主不在意地摆摆手。蛇岛人不怕那人来报复，了解蛇岛的人都不会轻易招惹他们，包括那些外来的大商人和旅人。而不了解他们蛇岛的，等招惹了他们蛇岛人后，自然会知道后果。
The stall owner waved his hand absently. The people of Snake Island are not afraid of that person's revenge, and no one who knows Snake Island will easily provoke them, including those big merchants and travelers from outside. Those who don't know about their Snake Island, after provoking their Snake Island people, will naturally know the consequences.
王叶和雷木更不在意。 Wang Ye and Lei Mu didn't care even more.
王叶买到了心仪的主材料，接下来就是选择一块能做琴杆、琴筒、琴轴、琴托的好木料。
Wang Ye bought the main material he liked, and the next thing was to choose a good piece of wood that could be used as a stem, barrel, shaft, and holder.
除此之外，还有琴码、琴弓和琴弦的材料。 In addition to this, there are materials for the saddle, bow, and strings.
琴码和琴弓的材料都好找，琴弦比较麻烦，他不想选择不太结实的蚕丝弦，但好的钢丝弦在游戏中也不容易得到，实在不行，他打算从地球弄一些琴弦凑合用。
The materials of the saddle and bow are easy to find, the strings are more troublesome, he doesn't want to choose silk strings that are not too strong, but good steel strings are not easy to get in the game, it really can't be done, he plans to get some strings from the earth to make do.
如果不是因果武器最好是自己制作，他都想省事一点直接在地球买一把。
If it's not a causal weapon, it's better to make it himself, and he wants to save a little trouble and buy one directly on Earth.
没错，王叶的因果武器就是二胡。 That's right, Wang Ye's causal weapon is the erhu.
而他会选择二胡做他的因果武器，也和上辈子的经历有关。
And he will choose erhu as his causal weapon, which is also related to the experience of his previous life.
他在跑出儿童福利院后曾流浪了一阵子，那时他遇到了一个在街头卖艺的拉二胡老头。
He wandered for a while after he ran out of the children's welfare home, when he met an old man who was a street performer.
也不能说遇到，是他瞄上了对方的钱盒。 It can't be said that he met it, it was he who targeted the other party's money box.
那时他饿得要死，正想着要怎么赚钱，就看到地下通道的中间有个瞎子老头在拉二胡。
At that time, he was starving to death, and was thinking about how to make money, when he saw a blind old man playing erhu in the middle of the underground passage.
过来过去的行人偶尔会往老头身前的铁盒子里丢点零钱，王叶亲眼看到有人扔了一张一百的大钞进去。
Pedestrians who passed by occasionally threw some change into the iron box in front of the old man, and Wang Ye saw someone throw a hundred bills into it.
他就一直盯着那张百元大钞，恨不得吹口气，把那张钞票吹出来。
He kept staring at the hundred-dollar bill, eager to blow it out.
但那天没风，地下通道的风更近乎于无，不管他怎么用意念发功，那钞票都躺在铁盒里纹丝不动。
But there was no wind that day, and the wind in the underground passage was almost none, and no matter how much he tried to exert his mind, the money lay in the tin box and did not move.
在不知不觉间，他越来越接近那老头。 Before he knew it, he was getting closer and closer to the old man.
但王叶觉得自己偷一个瞎子老头的钱太没品，他就蹲在老头旁边，希望别人也给他扔钱。
But Wang Ye felt that it was too tasteless to steal money from a blind old man, so he squatted next to the old man, hoping that others would also throw money at him.
然后真有人给他扔钱了，但扔钱的人八成以为他是老头的孙子，竟然对他笑笑后，把钱放进了老头的钱盒里……
Then someone really threw money at him, but eighty percent of the people who threw the money thought that he was the grandson of the old man, and after smiling at him, he put the money in the old man's money box......
就在他快要被饥饿感打倒，决定从瞎子老头的钱盒里摸走那张百元大钞的时候，老头停止了拉琴，第一件事就是收起钱盒。
Just when he was about to be overwhelmed by hunger and decided to take the hundred-dollar bill from the blind old man's money box, the old man stopped playing the violin, and the first thing he did was to put away the money box.
王叶那时还不知道老头只是戴着墨镜，不是真瞎。就拉住老头跟他耍赖，说他帮他看守了半天钱盒，老头得付他工资。
Wang Ye didn't know at that time that the old man was just wearing sunglasses, not really blind. He grabbed the old man and played tricks on him, saying that he had helped him guard the money box for a long time, and the old man had to pay him a salary.
老头就问他想要多少，他玩了点小心眼说只要十块钱。 The old man asked him how much he wanted, and he said with a little caution that it would only cost ten dollars.
老头问他要十块钱干什么。 The old man asked him what he was doing for ten dollars.
他的肚子就很应景地叫起来。 His stomach crumbled at the right time.
后来老头带他去吃了一顿饭，但也仅仅如此，并没有做多余的事情。
Later, the old man took him to a meal, but it was nothing more than that, and he did not do anything superfluous.
但他尝到甜头，第二天又跑到那个地下通道，而那老头也又来了。
But he tasted the sweetness, and the next day he ran to the underground passage, and the old man came again.
就这么一来二去，他跟老头熟悉起来，老头也知道他无家可归，但并没有把他带回家抚养。
In this way, he became familiar with the old man, and the old man also knew that he was homeless, but did not take him home to raise him.
说句好笑的话，他那时还挺失望的。 To put it mildly, he was quite disappointed.
老头是个孤寡，据说曾经在某个大戏剧团里担任二胡手，后来退休了，无妻无子无亲戚，就那么一个人过日子，无聊的时候就到外面拉拉二胡，顺便还能赚点小钱。
The old man is a lonely widow, it is said that he once worked as an erhu player in a big drama troupe, and later retired, without a wife, no children and no relatives, so he lives alone, and when he is bored, he goes outside to pull the erhu, and by the way, he can make a little money.
王叶从八岁半到十六岁，一直跟老头有接触。老头心情好就教他拉二胡和制作二胡，也不问王叶住在哪里、平时做什么。
Wang Ye was from eight and a half years old to sixteen years old, and he had been in contact with the old man. When the old man was in a good mood, he taught him to play and make erhu, and he didn't ask Wang Ye where he lived or what he usually did.
王叶没事就给老头打打下手，如果老头能把制作好的二胡卖出去，就会给他一点零花钱当工资。
Wang Ye will give the old man a hand if he has nothing to do, and if the old man can sell the made erhu, he will give him a little pocket money as a salary.
那段时期，王叶为了养活自己，给一个所谓的道上大哥养狗，藏獒。
During that period, in order to support himself, Wang Ye raised a dog for a so-called big brother on the road, a Tibetan mastiff.
而他能找到这么一个包吃住的活计，就因为别人都不敢接近那两只藏獒，就他敢。
And he was able to find such a job to eat and live, just because no one else dared to approach the two Tibetan mastiffs, he dared.
王叶十六岁生日时，用养狗赚来的工资买了一个蛋糕去找老头，却发现老头躺在床上身体都凉了。
其实老头年龄已经不小，八十多了，要不是有王叶陪着，他恐怕还坚持不了这么长时间。
In fact, the old man is not young, more than eighty years old, if it weren't for Wang Ye by his side, he probably wouldn't have lasted so long.
直到老头死亡，王叶打电话报警，在一片乱哄哄中才知道老头早就得了胃癌，能熬这么多年已经是奇迹。
It wasn't until the old man died that Wang Ye called the police, and in the chaos, he learned that the old man had already had stomach cancer, and it was a miracle that he could survive for so many years.
王叶和老头没有任何关系，说是老头的弟子，但也没有任何继承权，老头的家产和房产自然和他没有丝毫关系。
Wang Ye has nothing to do with the old man, saying that he is the old man's disciple, but he does not have any inheritance rights, and the old man's family property and real estate naturally have nothing to do with him.
而且他以为无儿无女的老头并不是真的无儿无女，他有一个儿子，因为某些历史原因，他和妻子分开，这个儿子也从小被妻子带走，和他几乎毫无往来。
And he thought that the old man who had no children and no daughters was not really childless, he had a son, for some historical reasons, he was separated from his wife, and this son was also taken away by his wife since he was a child, and he had almost no contact with him.
但在老头死后，警方通知了那边。 But after the old man's death, the police notified the other side.
老头的儿子过来，继承了老头的所有遗产。
对于他这个弟子，老头的儿孙没有亲近，也没有过多逼迫。
虽然那人的老婆说酸话，说老头这么多年肯定有存款，问这些存款都哪里去了，是不是给这个小子拿走了。意思是想通过警方把这笔不知道是多少的未知存款从王叶那里拿回来。
但老头儿子表现得像是还有点良知，说他们已经得到房产和屋子里的所有东西，就别再那么贪了。说他这个做儿子没赡养过老头一天，老头临终几年都是这个小弟子在照顾，老头把自己的存款给他也是应该的。
实际上，老头儿子心里很清楚，他这个老父亲一直在给他老娘寄钱。而老头就靠一点微薄的退休金生活，扣除老头寄给他们的钱，再扣除生活费和医药费，老头就算有些存款，也不会有多少，而且他还拿到了老头的退休工资卡。
王叶懒得理会这家人，也不想看他们演戏，他压根就没有拿过老头一分存款。
他不欠老头的。

第48章 教认字和勘破 Chapter 48 Teaching Literacy and Investigation

第49章 毒和干架
雷木在傍晚前赶了回来。
他把药泥洞里的药泥装走了一半，再多两桶。
他们行动之前已经问过村长和船锚的意思，他们听说两人可以把药泥送到拍卖会拍卖，自然没有不同意的，还非常期待能拍出高价来。
王叶只让雷木取了他们自己的一半，多出来的两桶就是帮村子拍卖的。
好东西之所以被称为好东西，不仅仅是因为它们具有某些特别效果，还因为它们数量少。
而想要在拍卖会上拍出高价的好东西，更是不能提供太多。
王叶把药泥放到拍卖会上拍卖，也是给药泥估个价，这样将来海沟村人出手药泥，也知道该要多少补偿。
同样，药泥足够珍贵和高价，才会让人更重视其。
王叶跟村长和船锚介绍了岩药师的情况，重点说明：“除了他人品比较不错，又是中级药师，对一些不怀好意的人有一定震慑性。还有就是他经常跑这条航线，每年都会跑一到两次，这就表示他能看顾到你们和海岛。而他又不是个喜欢竭泽而渔的人。如此，他是最有可能把药泥洞保护起来进行长期开发和保护的人。同样，为了岛上的紫珠叶等药草，他也不会随便破坏岛上环境。”

第52章 船上交易会 Chapter 52: Ship Fair

Wang Ye was in a very good mood, first, he didn't waste the task, and if he did this, he could not only earn money, but also earn experience points and the power of cause and effect. Second, he has more money, which can also allow him to choose some good materials to make causal weapons.
这让他在上船时遇到海草岛岛主一行，也保持了笑脸。 This made him meet the owner of Seagrass Island and his party when he got on the boat, and he also kept a smile.
当然，他的笑脸不是对着海草岛人，而是对着雷木。 Of course, his smiling face was not directed at the Seagrass Islanders, but at Raimu.
富秀山却特意从船板上走下来，过来跟两人打招呼。 Fu Xiushan deliberately stepped down from the board of the boat and came over to greet the two.
之前他去跟海沟村人道歉，因为王叶忙着制作解药，就没见他。
Before that, he went to apologize to the people of Haigou Village, because Wang Ye was busy making the antidote, so he didn't see him.
富秀山不认识王叶，但他身边的人认识，看到王叶和雷木，就跟富秀山说了两人身份。
Fu Xiushan didn't know Wang Ye, but the people around him knew, and when he saw Wang Ye and Lei Mu, he told Fu Xiushan about their identities.
富秀山一看两人也有请柬，顿时更对两人高看三分。 Fu Xiushan saw that the two of them also had invitations, and suddenly looked up to the two of them by three points.
今晚这个在最大商船上召开的交易会，可不是谁都能上来，要么你得有钱，要么你得有身份，要么你就得有拿得出手的宝贝。
Tonight's trade fair on the largest merchant ship is not for everyone, either you have to have money, or you have to have status, or you have to have a treasure.
富秀山特意跟王叶打招呼，还存了一个心思。 Fu Xiushan specially greeted Wang Ye and had a thought.
富奇器得罪了这对兄弟，八成是要和他父亲一样废掉了，那么他们海草岛就没了正式的药师学徒，而以富奇器的性子，恐怕宁可把那些药草知识烂在肚子里，也不会愿意教导村人。
Fu Qi Qi offended the two brothers, and eighty percent of them were going to be abolished like his father, so they would have no formal pharmacist apprentices on Seagrass Island, and with Fu Qi Qi's temperament, I am afraid that they would rather rot those medicinal herb knowledge in their stomachs than be willing to teach the villagers.
既然如此，村里就很有必要再寻找一个药师学徒，如果是药师那就更好。
In this case, it is necessary for the village to find another pharmacist apprentice, and if it is a pharmacist, it is even better.
为什么不说培养？ Why not talk about cultivating?
因为药师就不是那么容易培养的，首先你得找到愿意收你的药师，还要有丰厚的家产，这年头想要学什么你都得花钱，尤其是像药师这样吃香的职业。
Because pharmacists are not so easy to train, first of all, you have to find pharmacists who are willing to accept you, and you also have to have a good family property, and you have to spend money on everything you want to learn in these years, especially a popular profession like a pharmacist.
拜师就得花一笔钱。 Apprenticeship costs a sum of money.
求学期间更是要按时给老师贡上各种节日礼物，其实就是缴学费。
During the study period, it is necessary to pay various holiday gifts to the teacher on time, which is actually to pay the tuition fee.
而学习药草更需要大量的药草练手，这些药草可都得自己买，做老师的一般很少提供。
Learning herbs requires a lot of herb practice, and these herbs have to be bought by themselves, and teachers generally rarely provide them.
也有专门的药师学校，但那种学校不说考进去十分困难，就是学费也不是一般人能付得起，更因为路途遥远，只能照顾到周边地区。
There are also specialized pharmacist schools, but not to mention that it is very difficult to get in, even the tuition fees are not affordable for ordinary people, and because of the long distance, they can only take care of the surrounding areas.
所以双月星人想要成为药师，绝大多数还是找个药师甚至是药师学徒来拜师学艺。
Therefore, if the people of the Double Moon Star want to become a pharmacist, most of them still find a pharmacist or even a pharmacist apprentice to learn the arts.
可就算你找到愿意教你的老师，并且有支持你学习的财力，最后能否学成还得看你的天赋和运气。
But even if you find a teacher who is willing to teach you and has the financial resources to support your learning, it depends on your talent and luck whether you can succeed in the end.
海草村有钱后，送出去学习各种技艺的人每年都不会少于三五人，但真正学成并愿意回到岛上的，除了武者以外，药师学徒至今也只有一个富奇器。
After Seagrass Village has money, there will be no less than three or five people sent out to learn various skills every year, but those who have really learned and are willing to return to the island, in addition to the martial artists, the pharmacist apprentice has only one Fuqi weapon so far.
培养的路暂时走不通，那就只能找个现成的。 The path of cultivation can't go for the time being, so you can only find a ready-made one.
富秀山在详细打听了海沟村两位贵客的情况后，心里就冒出了一个想法。
After inquiring in detail about the situation of the two distinguished guests in Haigou Village, Fu Xiushan had an idea in his heart.
在他看来王叶只是一个小孩子，他既然能被海沟村人笼络，那自然也能接受其他人的笼络。
In his opinion, Wang Ye is just a child, since he can be encircled by the people of Haigou Village, he can naturally accept the entrapment of others.
他们海草村怎么说基本条件也比海沟村好得多，富秀山相信如果他们能对王叶足够恭敬，并愿意付出让他满意的酬劳，小孩说不定就会留在他们海草岛。
The basic conditions of their Seagrass Village are much better than those of Haigou Village, and Fu Xiushan believes that if they can be respectful enough to Wang Ye and are willing to pay him a satisfactory reward, the child may stay on their Seagrass Island.
当然，除了王叶自己的想法，他身边那个宛如护卫一般的兄长的意见也很重要，也是他要攻克的目标。
Of course, in addition to Wang Ye's own thoughts, the opinion of the brother who was like a guard by his side was also very important, and it was also the goal he wanted to overcome.
富秀山也不是特别急，他愿意给出时间让两人考虑，并让他们看到海草岛的诚意。
Fu Xiushan is not particularly anxious, he is willing to give time for the two to think about it, and let them see the sincerity of Seagrass Island.
王叶就听这位海草岛岛主对他一个小孩子说了许多能让人尴尬得抠出一个游泳池的恭维话。
Wang Ye listened to the owner of Seagrass Island say a lot of compliments to a child that could make people embarrassed to pull out a swimming pool.
如果他真是一个小孩子，这时候恐怕早就被夸得飘起来，或者羞红脸？
If he was really a child, I am afraid that he would have been praised at this time, or blushed?
可惜他就是刷绿漆装嫩的老梆子，脸皮厚比地球直径，对于这位的夸奖全盘接受，没有半点不良反应。
It's a pity that he is an old man who pretends to be tender with green paint, and his skin is thicker than the diameter of the earth.
富秀山又夸又捧说了很久，结果两兄弟，大的没有丝毫反应，小的则昂着脑袋不时点头附和“就是”、“没错”、“你说的太对了，我就是这么了不起”。
Fu Xiushan praised and praised for a long time, but the two brothers, the eldest did not react in the slightest, and the younger one held his head high and nodded from time to time in echo, "Yes", "That's right", "What you said is so right, I'm so amazing".
最后导致他这个夸人的都快尴尬地说不下去。 In the end, he was embarrassed to say it.
“听说二位在鄙村租了一个院子居住？如果二位喜欢海草岛的风景，我们非常欢迎二位来常住。二位喜欢岛上房屋的风格吗？要不就照样子给两位新建一座？要多大？比现在的院子大三倍，再带五亩药田如何？”
"I heard that the two of you rented a yard to live in the village? If you like the view of Seagrass Island, you are more than welcome to come and stay for a permanent stay. Do you like the style of the houses on the island? Why don't you build a new one for the two of you? How big is it to be? It's three times bigger than the current yard, and how about bringing another five acres of medicine fields? ”
王叶特别诚实地说：“你们岛留不住我，我和我哥是属于星辰大海的。海沟村人让我做岛主，我都不愿意。”
Wang Ye said very honestly: "Your island can't keep me, my brother and I belong to the sea of stars." The people of Trench Village asked me to be the owner of the island, but I didn't want to. ”
富秀山：“……” Fu Xiushan: "......"
王叶见富秀山再也说不下去，找了个借口就匆忙带着海草岛人离开，嘴角翘了翘。
Wang Ye saw that Fu Xiushan couldn't talk anymore, so he made an excuse and hurriedly left with the people of Seagrass Island, and the corners of his mouth curled.
雷木也露出了淡淡的笑容。小叶子真的不同于一般的小孩子，如果富秀山或其他什么人把他当小孩子哄，那最后被“哄”的还不知道是谁。
Remu also showed a faint smile. Xiao Yezi is really different from ordinary children, if Fu Xiushan or someone else coaxes him as a child, then I don't know who was "coaxed" in the end.
“两位贵客，交易会在一层甲板和船舱举行，拍卖会在二楼。不过拍卖会的时间要到晚上八点才开始，现在时间还早，两位可以先在一层甲板的交易会上逛逛。另外，还请两位注意，船上不允许任何打斗，如果发生矛盾，要么请下船，要么请找船上侍者调解。”检查过两人请柬的护卫跟两人礼貌解说道。
"Two distinguished guests, the fair will be held on the first deck and cabin, and the auction will be on the second floor. However, the auction will not start until 8 p.m., and it is still early, so the two of you can take a stroll through the trade fair on the first deck. In addition, please note that no fights are allowed on the boat, and if there is a conflict, either disembark or ask the waiter on board to mediate. The guard who had checked the invitation cards of the two men politely explained to the two of them.
“了解。” "Understood."
两人并没有去交易会，而是先上了二楼，找到拍卖会负责人，拿出三样东西要求拍卖。
The two did not go to the fair, but went up to the second floor first, found the person in charge of the auction, and took out three things to ask for auction.
在拿到请柬时，王叶就看到请柬下方注明了拍卖行的名字，这让他对这场拍卖会十分放心。
When he got the invitation, Wang Ye saw the name of the auction house indicated under the invitation, which made him very relieved about this auction.
这场拍卖会的发起人和佣兵公会有莫大关系，说白了，这家拍卖行属于佣兵公会，同时也是双月星最大的拍卖行。
The initiator of this auction has a lot to do with the Mercenary Guild, to put it bluntly, this auction house belongs to the Mercenary Guild, and it is also the largest auction house of Double Moon Star.
有佣兵公会做后台和背书，这个叫做“拍立得”的拍卖行信誉度非常高，王叶上辈子到死为止都没有听过这家拍卖行的负面消息。
There is a mercenary guild to do the backstage and endorsement, this auction house called "Polaroid" has a very high reputation, and Wang Ye has never heard negative news about this auction house until his death in his previous life.
像是一般拍卖行可能会有的暴露拍卖者和拍买者信息、以及黑吃黑的事情，这家拍立得都没有。
For example, the general auction house may have the information of the auctioneer and the auctioneer, as well as the black and black things, this Polaroid does not have.
说来，这家拍卖行的名字也是让王叶长时间以为这个世界就是一个游戏的重要原因之一，会给拍卖行取这样的名字，也只有地球人了，还得是地球华夏人。
Speaking of which, the name of this auction house is also one of the important reasons why Wang Ye thought that this world was a game for a long time, and he would give the auction house such a name, and only the earthlings would be earthlings, and they had to be earthlings.
虽然也有可能是巧合，但这种巧合诞生的概率真的太低太低。
Although it may also be a coincidence, the probability of such a coincidence is really too low and too low.
拍立得的工作人员果然十分专业，接待人在确定他们拿出的三样东西都和药物有关后，就请出了一位药师。
The Polaroid staff was very professional, and after making sure that the three things they took out were all related to medicine, they hired a pharmacist.
但药师并没有见到王叶和雷木，他只在室内负责鉴定送拍的材料。
However, the pharmacist did not see Wang Ye and Lei Mu, and he was only responsible for appraising the materials submitted for auction indoors.
没多久，工作人员就得到回复，热情地对两人说道：“非常荣幸两位能选择鄙拍卖行，这是我们的鉴定人员对两位送拍物品的初步鉴定价，也是上拍卖会的底价。因为两位送拍的物品属于珍品，两位可以选择两种拍卖方式，一种是让鄙行买断，一种是拍卖。”
It didn't take long for the staff to get a reply and enthusiastically said to the two: "It's a great honor for the two of you to choose the auction house, which is the preliminary appraisal price of the two items submitted for auction by our appraisers, and it is also the reserve price for the auction." Because the items submitted for auction belong to treasures, the two can choose two auction methods, one is to let the disdainful bank buy out, and the other is auction. ”
王叶看了底价，还算满意。负责鉴定的人有两把刷子，没看走眼。
Wang Ye looked at the reserve price and was quite satisfied. The person in charge of the appraisal had two brushes and didn't look away.
工作人员恰到好处地停顿一下，继续道：“如果选择前者，二位无需付出任何手续费，鄙行会按照鉴定价立即结算。”
The staff paused appropriately and continued: "If you choose the former, you don't need to pay any handling fees, and you will settle it immediately according to the appraisal price. ”
“如果选择后者，鄙行不会付出任何费用，只会出具一张收到拍品的魔法证明单。因为两位持有的是贵宾邀请函，拍卖手续费将会减半，只收取百分之五。不过选择后者很有可能流拍，对于流拍的拍品，鄙行会按照鉴定价收取手续费，还请理解。”
"If you choose the latter, you won't pay anything, you will only be issued a magic certificate of receipt of the lot. Since the two are in possession of VIP invitations, the auction fee will be halved to only 5%. However, if you choose the latter, it is very likely that the auction will be unsuccessful, and for the unsold lots, you will charge a handling fee according to the appraisal price, please understand. ”
王叶在雷木手掌心画了个数字2。 Wang Ye drew a number 2 on the palm of Lei Mu's hand.
雷木：“我们选择拍卖。” Remu: "We choose the auction. ”
“好的，请稍等。” "Okay, wait a minute."
等了大约五分钟，两人拿到了拍立得出具的魔法收据。 After waiting for about five minutes, the two got their hands on the magic receipt from the Polaroid.
收据上除了拍卖行相关经手人的签名，另具有拍品的详细信息，还包括一张立体还能观看多个角度的魔法照片。
In addition to the signature of the person who handled the auction house, the receipt also contains details of the lot, as well as a three-dimensional magic photo that can be viewed from multiple angles.
这样的魔法收据，本身就价值不菲，有时拍品的价格还不如这张收据，不过借此也能看出拍立得的财大气粗。
Such a magic receipt is worth a lot of money in itself, and sometimes the price of the lot is not as good as this receipt, but it also shows the wealth of the Polaroid.
距离拍卖会还有一段时间，两人就去一楼逛交易会了。 There was still some time before the auction, and the two went to the first floor to visit the fair.
一楼现在已经很热闹，宛如展销会一样的摊点在甲板上面对面摆开，更贵重的则在船舱中。
The ground floor is now bustling with showcase-like stalls facing each other on the deck, and the more expensive ones in the cabins.
王叶在一个卖木料的摊点前停下脚步。 Wang Ye stopped in front of a stall selling wood.
因为摊位有限，摊主拿出的都是不大的样品，一块块颜色和质地各异的方形木块就摆在亚麻桌布上。
Because of the limited number of stalls, the stall owners brought out small samples, square wooden blocks of different colors and textures on linen tablecloths.
王叶挨个拿起自己感兴趣的木料，一一感受。 Wang Ye picked up the woods he was interested in one by one and felt them one by one.
他在市集里也逛过，没找到特别好的木料，而这个摊子上的木料质量就好多了，其中就好几种都很适合做琴身。
He also walked around the market, but he couldn't find any good wood, and the quality of the wood in this stall was much better, and several of them were very suitable for making the body.
“这是黑金紫檀？”王叶拿起一块木料询问。 "This is black gold rosewood?" Wang Ye picked up a piece of wood and asked.
摊主见是一个小孩询问，且穿的衣服只是普通麻料，并不是很热情地回答：“嗯。”还加了一句：“这木料很贵，不是小孩能玩的玩具。”
When the stall owner saw that it was a child and asked about the clothes he was wearing, he didn't reply very enthusiastically: "Yes." He added: "This wood is very expensive, and it is not a toy that children can play with." ”
摊主也看到雷木了，这才没有轰王叶离开。 The stall owner also saw Lei Mu, so he didn't leave Wang Ye.
王叶也不在意对方的态度，“我要买一块两米长、半米厚的黑金紫檀木料，有吗？”
Wang Ye didn't care about the other party's attitude, "I want to buy a piece of black gold rosewood that is two meters long and half a meter thick, is there one?" ”
摊主讶然，又失笑：“小孩，你是不是听你家大人说过黑金紫檀是特别好的木料？那你有没有听过这种木料想要半米厚的除非拼接？”
The stall owner was surprised, and laughed again: "Child, have you heard that your adults have said that black gold rosewood is a particularly good wood?" Have you ever heard of this kind of wood that wants to be half a meter thick unless it is spliced? ”
“知道啊，我这不是想碰碰运气嘛。”王叶耸肩。 "Yes, I didn't mean to try my luck." Wang Ye shrugged.
摊主笑，正好也没其他客人，见小孩又一副人小鬼大的样子，就和他聊起来：“我也想有这样的运气，可目前为止发现的黑金紫檀，最大一颗料的直径也只有二十厘米，就这，两米长的料子，还不保证是直料，最少也要一百个金币。”
The stall owner smiled, and there were no other guests, and when he saw that the child looked like a small ghost, he chatted with him: "I also want to have such luck, but the diameter of the largest piece of black gold rosewood found so far is only twenty centimeters, and this is it, the two-meter-long material is not guaranteed to be a straight material, and it takes at least a hundred gold coins." ”
“那你现在手上最大的黑金紫檀料是什么尺寸？” "Then what is the size of the largest black gold rosewood material you have in your hand right now?"
“一米五长，厚度三厘米。弯料，不直。” "One meter and five long, three centimeters thick. Bent, not straight. ”
“价格？” "Price?"
摊主随口道：“十五金币一张，不还价。” The stall owner said casually: "Fifteen gold coins a piece, no counteroffer." ”
王叶对比了下上辈子知道的黑金紫檀价格，觉得相差不大，就道：“拿出来我看看，如果是真料子，我就买了。”
Wang Ye compared the price of black gold red sandalwood that he knew in his previous life, and felt that there was not much difference, so he said: "Take it out and I'll take a look, if it's the real thing, I'll buy it." ”
摊主惊讶：“你真要买？” The stall owner was surprised: "Do you really want to buy it?" ”
王叶很不可爱地冲道：“你觉得我很闲？闲到逗你玩？”
Wang Ye rushed unlovably: "You think I'm idle? Idle enough to amuse you? ”
摊主立马变了脸，之前的冷淡再也不见，脸上堆满了笑容：“怎么会呢，一看这位小少爷就知道是干大事的，您稍等，我这就让人把木料送过来！保证您是真品，如果有假的，咱也上不了这艘船。”
The stall owner's face immediately changed, the previous coldness was no longer gone, and his face was full of smiles: "How can it be, as soon as I look at this little master, I know that he is doing something big, you wait a minute, I will let someone send the wood over!" Guarantee that you are genuine, if there is a fake, we will not be able to get on this ship. ”
王叶不想干等，还想去其他摊子上看看，摊主怕这个好不容易得来的大主顾跑掉，忙跟他推荐其他木料，又问他买木料是做什么用处，他可以根据王叶的需要帮他推荐适合的木料。
Wang Ye didn't want to wait, but also wanted to go to other stalls to see, the stall owner was afraid that this hard-won big customer would run away, so he was busy recommending other wood to him, and asked him what the use of buying wood was, he could help him recommend suitable wood according to Wang Ye's needs.
王叶用不着摊主介绍，也不需要其他代替木料，拉着雷木的手就去逛其他摊位。

However, the threshold for this auction is not high, as long as anyone who gets the invitation card can enter the auction room, and because this auction is held on a ship, due to space limitations, there are very few VIP private rooms.
所谓的贵宾包间就是二楼几个船舱。 The so-called VIP private rooms are several cabins on the second floor.
像是海草岛岛主都没有资格进入包间，包括王叶和雷木也是。
For example, the owner of Seagrass Island is not eligible to enter the private room, including Wang Ye and Lei Mu.
拍卖台位于二楼正中的甲板边沿，以拍卖台为中心，座位呈弧形散开。
The auction table is located on the edge of the deck in the middle of the second floor, with the auction table as the center, and the seats are spread out in an arc.
有些客人甚至没有座位，只能站着。他们也不能往前挤，只能站在座椅后方的空地。
Some guests don't even have seats and have to stand. They couldn't squeeze forward, they had to stand in the open space behind their seats.
不过为了免除这些客人的尴尬，船上沿着栏杆准备了一排排的美食和酒水，任客人随意取用。
However, in order to avoid the embarrassment of these guests, rows of food and drinks are prepared along the railings of the boat for the guests to take as they please.
王叶端着一个大盘子，拉着雷木就围着那些自助美食转，看到好吃的就拿两块，自己一块，再分雷木一块。
Wang Ye held a large plate, pulled Lei Mu around those buffet delicacies, and when he saw something delicious, he took two pieces, one for himself, and then divided one for Lei Mu.
有人对王叶这种行为很不屑，更在打量两人的穿着佩饰后就确定这两个大概是好运被带进来的普通人，但也没有人傻到把自己的鄙视说出来。
Some people were very disdainful of Wang Ye's behavior, and after looking at the clothes and ornaments of the two, they determined that these two were probably ordinary people who were brought in with good luck, but no one was stupid enough to say their contempt.

王叶和雷木在某种程度上可以说是活得很自我的人，丝毫不在乎别人的目光，想吃就吃，想喝就喝。
Wang Ye and Lei Mu can be said to be self-conscious people to a certain extent, they don't care about other people's eyes at all, they eat when they want to eat, and they drink when they want.
一名战士装束、精气神特别足的中年人走上拍卖台，朗声道：“诸位贵客，拍卖会即将开始。首先说明，除了拍卖册上已经记录的拍品，这段时间也有一些新的拍品加入，但因为时间关系，并没有在拍卖册上做记录，诸位也可以把这些没有记录的拍品当做惊喜。”
A middle-aged man in warrior costume and with a special spirit walked up to the auction table and said loudly: "Distinguished guests, the auction is about to begin. First of all, in addition to the lots that have been recorded in the auction book, there are also some new lots added during this time, but due to time constraints, they have not been recorded in the auction book, and you can also take these unrecorded lots as a surprise. ”
会场客人发出了然的笑声，这种事情在拍卖会场中经常出现。
The guests at the venue let out a heartfelt laugh, which is often the case in auction rooms.
“作为拍卖师，我唯一可以告诉大家的是，没有被记录的拍品，个别的珍贵程度并不亚于我们的开场和压轴品。”
"The only thing I can tell as an auctioneer is that the individual lots that are not recorded are as precious as our opening and finale."
这次会场传来低低的喧哗声，有不少人都露出了感兴趣的神情。
This time, there was a low noise in the venue, and many people showed expressions of interest.

Recently, however, someone sent in a lot, and after urgent discussions above, it was decided to make it the opening lot. ”

Lu Tiancheng was originally on par with the strength of this mercenary leader, and he was slightly stronger, but after being poisoned, his battle qi was seriously lost, which caused his current strength to be two points weaker than that regiment leader.

烈苍脸上露出奇怪神情，但不是惊讶，而是一种“原来你也碰上了”的安心和信任表情。
烈苍甚至笑起来：“我就在想你们俩救了我们村这么多人，连爷爷怎么可能没有一点表示，原来他已经找你们了。”
“连爷爷？”
“嗯，连爷爷就是这栋木屋的主人。”烈苍点头，对两人招手：“既然连爷爷邀请你们了，那你们跟我来吧。”
两人莫名所以地跟在烈苍身后。
烈苍绕到屋后，拨开草丛，拎起地窖入口的木板，自己率先走了下去。
雷木和王叶对望，两人也跟了下去。
地窖里意外的很干净，而且里面生活用具和床铺齐全，就像一个经常有人住的住处。
烈苍像主人一样的伸手介绍：“这就是我家，我母亲失踪以后，连爷爷就让我住在这里。”
“那位连爷爷还活着？”
烈苍点起油灯，一手持油灯，一手按到一扇小门上，摇摇头：“连爷爷很早就去世了。你们不要害怕，一开始我也很害怕，但和连爷爷接触后你们就会知道连爷爷是好人，他一直在试图守护这岛上的村民。”
烈苍推开小门，弯腰钻进去。
两人只好跟上。
小门过后是一条往上的狭窄通道，上面还有一扇门，推开就是小木屋内。
两人上来进入小木屋，第一眼就看到木屋正中的地面裂开了一个大洞。
洞的形状特别像人的嘴巴，看着瘆人。
烈苍忽然发出嘿嘿笑声：“原来这个裂口不是这个样子，是我慢慢搞出来的，大家看到都很害怕。”
王叶和雷木：“……”
王叶：没想到你是这样的烈苍！
烈苍指了指裂口：“想要找到正确的入口，只有两种方法，一种是得到连爷爷的邀请，一种就是得到我的邀请，从地窖那边进来。否则进来的人就算看到裂口，也会掉到其他地方，不会到达连爷爷那里。”
王叶：这是从动物世界跳到怪异事件频道了吗？下一站是不是走进科学？
雷木拉住王叶，不让他靠近裂口，语气冷淡地对少年烈苍道：“你带我们来这里是什么意思？你是不是知道我们要过来？”
烈苍委屈：“明明是你们先找到这里，也是你们说连爷爷邀请了你们，你们又救了村人，我才想带你们去见连爷爷，如果你们不想去，那就算了。”
王叶想到上辈子烈苍那嫉恶如仇的性子，决定多给这名少年一点信任：“能跟我们说说那位连爷爷的事情吗？”
烈苍对王叶好感更强，而且他自诩是村里所有孩子的头，对所有年龄比他小的孩子都有一种关照心理，见王叶跟他说话，表情就缓和了一些，索性在坑边坐下，放下油灯道：“好啊。”
雷木在木屋里找了一条还没腐朽的长条木凳，拉着王叶一起坐下。
烈苍不是个擅长说故事的孩子，说话时还经常丢三落四，需要王叶和雷木询问，他才想起来补充一两句。
经过烈苍叙述，王叶拼凑出了一个关于连爷爷故事的大概。
这位连爷爷的原名叫连升，他是一名看守，轮值五年后，本来有机会离开囚犯岛，却因为喜欢上一个还没有刑满的女囚，也不放心她，就在岛上留了下来。
那时岛上还没有村落，就是一些刑满释放又不想离去的囚犯在岛上建了简单的房屋居住。连升那会儿还很年轻，也在岛上建了一座房子，就是这栋小木屋。
那时候的囚犯岛管理非常混乱，用连升的话说，那时的监狱长是个比最恶毒的囚犯还要恶毒的恶棍。
那时女囚的日子过得非常凄惨，男囚也好不到哪里去。
那时的监狱长喜欢看人打斗，经常在监狱里组织囚犯之间的比武，所谓比武其实就是互相用命搏杀，只有杀死对手才能继续活下去。
那时的监狱长还在监狱里搞出自治，也就是看守完全不管事，监狱全部交给囚犯自己管理，谁厉害谁做老大。
而谁给监狱长的孝敬多，谁就能得到食物等重要物资。
为了获得食物，也为了能长期压制其他囚犯，那些当老大的囚犯就会不停孝敬监狱长，他们没钱没东西，就拼命欺压其他囚犯。其他囚犯就强的欺负更弱小的，整个监狱简直比丛林还丛林。
外面有钱、家里也愿意付出的囚犯还好说，那些家里没钱或者家人不愿给钱的囚犯，如果不想活在最底层，就只能拼命压榨其他囚犯，想发设法搞出钱来孝敬上面的囚犯。
很多囚犯不堪折磨死掉了……
那样的监狱，可想而知有多可怕。
年轻的连升实在看不下去，就暗中串联其他同样看不过眼的看守，想要联名上告那名监狱长，让上面换个监狱长过来。
结果有人出卖连升，那位监狱长知道后，就把连升抓进监狱，让他和囚犯打斗，说如果活下来就放他离开。其实监狱长根本就没有放他离开的意思。
连升不愿意打斗，他还呼吁那些囚犯和看守一起反对监狱长，说人多力量大，只要大家一起反抗，监狱长也不敢做什么，大家的日子可以过得更好，不必为了一点本应该得到的食物就活得像野兽一样。
连升还对看守说，做人要有良心，问他们现在晚上能睡得安生吗，真的愿意和这样的监狱长一起同流合污吗？
其实囚犯们除了极个别人，谁愿意过这样的日子？
囚犯们开始骚动。
看守们看到连升被抓，心里也都不舒服，不是他们良知觉醒，而是今天监狱长能抓连升，把他随意丢入比斗场，那么明天是不是就会轮到他们？
监狱长大怒，命人把连升的爱人从女囚营抓来，当着连升的面，把那名女囚虐待至死。还不住问连升后不后悔得罪他。
最惨的是那女囚死时，已经怀孕八个月，就要生产。
监狱长最后剖开女囚的肚子，把连升的孩子取出来，当场丢给狗吃了。
连升在监狱长出手凌虐爱人时就疯了，等亲眼看到爱人和未出世的孩子惨死，连升也不想活了。他恨监狱长，恨出卖他的人，更恨自己。
连升打赢了第一个囚犯，但监狱长并没有信守诺言把他放出来，而是让其他囚犯进去继续和连升打。
连升实力不错，但也禁不住车轮战。
接连打了五场，连升被活活打死。
监狱长还觉得晦气，让人把连升的尸体和那女囚的尸体都拖去喂狗，还命令其他看守都看着。
监狱长想利用这招杀鸡儆猴，让其他看守都不敢不听他的话。
但并不是所有看守都良知泯灭，他们只是害怕监狱长的权威，不敢反抗他。
当他们看到曾经的同事连升死得那么惨，连即将出生的孩子都没保住，他们对监狱长的畏惧心变质了，变得充满憎恨。
三天后的深夜，监狱长的别墅内突然响起监狱长的惨叫。
监狱长从他的别墅内逃出来，不断大喊有鬼，还高喊连升的名字。
监狱长一路逃跑，想跑进看守的宿舍区，同时呼救。
那晚听到监狱长呼救的看守很多，但想要出去救人的看守被其他看守拦住。
当晚监狱长就死了，死得非常诡异也非常凄惨，开膛破肚，浑身都是伤，全身骨头都断了。
从头到尾看到监狱长死亡经过的看守都讳莫如深。
曾经出卖连升的看守疯了，他想夺船逃跑，却在跳进海水里推船时被毒海蜇蜇死。
曾经跟着监狱长做尽恶事的看守也在一个接一个死亡，他们想逃，却怎么都离不开看守宿舍和监狱区。
那时的看守宿舍都没人敢去住。
之后剩下的看守一起伪造了监狱长和一些手下出海捕鱼散心，遇到风暴再也没有回来的假消息，请上面重派监狱长。
上面派人来查看情况，但派来的那名贵族对囚犯岛厌恶无比，来了后竟然连船都没下，就让管事的上岛随便问了问，拿了看守们准备好的证据，就回去了。
之后，新的监狱长和新轮值的看守们来了，原先的大部分看守离去，只有少数几人留下。
就这样，一年又一年过去，新的监狱长来了又去，连升在传说中变成了连爷爷，他当年的事也没多少人知道了，但他原先居住的那栋木屋一直没有人敢占据，而且那座木屋那么久没人居住，竟然也没有腐败倒塌。
“连爷爷在杀了那个恶毒的监狱长以后，就一直待在岛上守护无辜者。他说这是他对自己的惩罚，他保护不了自己的妻儿，做事不周全连累她们，他就罚自己的灵魂不得安息。”烈苍长长叹息。
“他后悔对付那个监狱长了吗？”王叶忽然问。
烈苍一愣，随即用力摇头：“当然没有！连爷爷说他不后悔，他说这事必须有人领头做，如果没有人出头，那大家谁都不敢。他只恨自己做得还不够秘密，才导致事情没成功就先败露，他恨自己没有先保护好自己的爱人，恨自己考虑不全面。但他不后悔对付那个监狱长。”
“如果你以后遇到这样恶毒的人，是不是也会做和连爷爷同样的事情？”王叶又问。
“当然！”烈苍挺起胸膛，“强者必须保护弱者，这是强者存在的意义。强者不是用来欺压他人，强者的意义在于守护和拯救。你们不也是这样吗？”
王叶看得出来那位连爷爷的观念对烈苍影响很深。王叶不是这样正直的人，但他欣赏拥有这种观念的人。上辈子如果囚犯岛没有后来的事，烈苍应该会成长为一名顶天立地的伟男儿，成为无数人的保护者。
雷木看烈苍的眼神缓和了许多，语气也变得温和：“你知道那位连爷爷为什么找小叶子吗？”
烈苍吐气，猜测：“也许跟寄生虫族有关？连爷爷知道这岛上很多事情，但他不会把所有事情都告诉我，他说我还太小了，而且他不能和我经常交流，说人类和幽灵不能长期待在一起。”
“连爷爷是不是在教你武技？”王叶问。
烈苍眨眼，这个现在还没什么心眼的大男孩张口就道：“你怎么知道？”
王叶：很好，烈苍的机缘果然就在这座岛上。不过那位连爷爷有那么大本事把一个普通少年调教成武宗？还是三十岁的武宗？还是说那位连爷爷只是在给烈苍打基础，烈苍的机缘还没到？
王叶只是好奇，并没有抢夺烈苍机缘的意思，他已经有因果之力和虫巢，足够用了。
“你们还要去见连爷爷吗？”烈苍问。
王叶看向雷木，对他道：“我想去看看。”
雷木点头：“那就去吧。”
烈苍单手撑住坑边，“直接跳进来就可以。”说完，人就落入坑里。
王叶和雷木也跟着跳入坑中。
王叶留了个心眼，他给雷木和他自己都套上了一个【因果循环】保护罩。
落下的过程感觉中很长，实际很短。
粉尘溅起，王叶感到脚下踩住了什么软绵绵的东西，用手摸了摸，滑溜溜还有点韧性。
雷木伸手把王叶拉起来。
“你们没事吧？这里很安全。”烈苍显然已经习惯这种降落方式，落地很平稳，手里拿着的油灯都还好好的。
烈苍摸出火折子，吹燃，重新点燃油灯。
王叶觉得油灯的光太小，就拿出了两个矿灯，和雷木一人一个戴上，就戴在了手腕上。
烈苍对矿灯十分好奇，盯着看了半天，他似乎很想要一个，但不好意思开口。
王叶就假装没看到。
王叶再看那软绵绵的东西，上去摸了摸，心里有所猜测的同时施展了鉴定术。
果然是石棉矿石的风化物。
这些矿石风化或水化后，就留下了这种手感较为绵软的丝丝缕缕的纤维组织。这种纤维组织就是纺织石棉布的原材料。
石棉布是好东西，在古时候被称为火浣布，可以防火，脏了以后放在火中燃烧可以重新变得干净。
不过石棉这东西加工时产生的粉末容易造成严重的尘肺病，甚至致癌，并不适合拿出来当经济作物。
幸好他给雷木和自己都套上了因果循环保护罩。
王叶提醒烈苍：“以后这里你最好少来，要来也要蒙住脸，这里扬起的粉尘吸入身体无法排除，会残留在肺部，导致生病甚至死亡。”
烈苍张大嘴，又迅速捂上。
雷木轻声道：“这里是溶洞群。”
王叶也看出来了，这里应该是溶洞群的一部分，水分很足，而且这里风感很强烈，像是那种过道风。
烈苍原先不得不用手遮挡油灯，防止被吹灭。现在有两个矿灯照明，他就把油灯灭了。
“跟我来，往这边走。”烈苍走在前面带路。
王叶忽然睁大眼睛，就在刚才，他似乎看到烈苍背后出现了一个影子？
“你来了。”幽幽的声音在王叶耳边响起。
王叶飞快地握住雷木的手，贴到他身边，惊恐无比地道：“木木，鬼来了。”
雷木好笑地看他，这小子心里明明在笑。
第87章 石棉矿粉
“你不用害怕我，我不会伤害你。”也许是到了自己的地盘，幽灵放开了很多，他的声音都带着笑意。
“连升？连爷爷？”王叶小心翼翼地问。
连升笑：“是我。”
“你为什么吓我？”王小叶似乎仗着身边有人在，胆子变大，气呼呼地问。
“吓你？没有啊，我一看你就很有好感，从你做的事情也能看出，你是个好孩子，我想跟你聊聊。”
王叶：……上辈子加这辈子，他还是第一次听到有人说他是好孩子，尴尬。
“水潭里那个圆锥形的石屋是不是也和你有关？”王叶问。
连升笑，承认：“是啊，可惜你是个谨慎的孩子，我明明都邀请你了，你却跑掉了。”
“你管那叫邀请？”王叶无语：“你换一般孩子看看，早给你吓死了。别说孩子，大人也能给你吓懵。”
“所以至今为止只有大壮住进我家的地窖，还能来到这里。”连升幽幽道。
王叶眯了眯眼睛，从这位的口气听来，可真不像是什么一心保护弱者的好幽灵，就算他有这个心，也不是谁都保护。
感恩村除了大壮，弱小的孩子更多，还有很多孩子倒霉的失踪或死亡，也没见这幽灵跑出来救人。
“你……其实是后悔了吧？”王叶冷不丁道。
连升竟然也没生气，还回答王叶：“也不算后悔，只是愤怒。”
王叶：“愤怒那些看守和囚犯没有帮助你，反而助监狱长为虐？愤怒那些人就那么看着你和你的爱人孩子惨死，却什么也没做？愤怒那些人软弱悲哀，连自救都不愿意？愤怒人类天生的自私残忍寒凉本性？”
走在最前面的烈苍像是什么都没有察觉。
雷木有所察觉，他的眼睛发出光，正在用眼术扫视四周，重点看王叶身边。
王叶加重握住雷木的手。
雷木回握。
连升竟然赞叹道：“你果然不是一个普通的孩子，你对幽灵的害怕都是伪装出来的吧？”
连升真的很喜欢王叶，哪怕小孩言语并不尊重，他也没有因此对王叶产生恶感。
王叶没兴趣回答这个显而易见的问题，又问：“你是不是早就知道岛上有寄生虫族？为什么不早点告诉岛民？”
“你以为我没说吗？”连升冷笑：“可除了一个人，谁也没有相信我。而相信我的人，却……被我害了。”
王叶脑中迅速闪过一道讯息：“那人是上代监狱长？”
“你怎么知道？”连升反问。
王叶：“我偷听到变异体尤金和现在的监狱长对话，他提到前代监狱长是第一个被寄生虫族寄生的人。那时候寄生虫族还没准备寄生人类，但你告诉了前监狱长寄生虫族的事，加上村子有人失踪，那位前监狱长又是个极为负责的人，就进入溶洞群寻找，并一心想要找到寄生虫族的王虫和虫巢，然后才被寄生虫族寄生，我说的对吗？”
连升沉默，过了一会儿才回道：“对。”
“除了这位前监狱长，你就没有再把寄生虫族的事告诉其他人？”

终于，巨兽停了下来，它发现自己的伤势好不了了，那砸中它脖颈的东西不仅仅是天上掉落的石头，石头里面还有其他东西，那东西钻入它的身体，从内部吞噬它的血肉、吸食它的力量。
Finally, the beast stopped, and it found that its injuries were no longer healed, and that what had struck its neck was not just a stone falling from the sky, but there was something else in the stone, and that thing had burrowed into its body, devouring its flesh and blood from within, and sucking its power.

随便你吧，想看就看。

第89章 抱月养魂贝

第99章 解决方案 Chapter 99: Solution
这项链珍贵之处竟然不在于挂坠，而是在链子上。 The preciousness of this chain lies not in the pendant, but in the chain.
链子形状模仿竹节，每一节约1.5厘米长，直径约有0.4厘米，做工还算精细，上面只有淡淡的水纹。
The shape of the chain imitates that of bamboo, each one is 1.5 cm long and about 0.4 cm in diameter, and the workmanship is quite fine, with only a faint water pattern on it.
这样粗的项链并不适合女士佩戴，可能为了掩饰这种缺陷，有人对这条项链又做了一点变动，在项链下方又加了两条金链，形成复链，另外又加了一个水晶挂坠。
Such a thick necklace is not suitable for women to wear, perhaps in order to hide this defect, someone made a little change to this necklace, adding two gold chains under the necklace to form a double chain, and adding a crystal pendant.
主链和后加的复链都是黄金制成，可惜主链是金包木。 The main chain and the subsequent double chain are made of gold, but unfortunately the main chain is gold-clad wood.
鉴定师很可能由项链的体积和净重判断出这条项链并不是实心，可能也用机械检测出金子里面包含的是什么。
The appraiser is likely to have judged that the necklace was not solid by its volume and net weight, and may have mechanically detected what was contained in the gold.
如果金子包的是特殊木料还好，但就是很普通的橡木。 It's fine if the gold is wrapped in special wood, but it's just ordinary oak.
可能在鉴定师眼中，这就是过去人为了让金项链看起来比较粗、掂起来也比较重的一种作假手法。
Perhaps in the eyes of appraisers, this is a method of falsification in the past to make gold necklaces look thicker and heavier.
但他的鉴定结果还告诉了他另外一点，那就是竹节链的内侧刻有许多细微纹路。
But his results also told him another point, that is, there are many fine lines engraved on the inside of the bamboo chain.
这也是王叶觉得这条项链古怪之处。 This is also what Wang Ye finds this necklace strange.
一般来说，项链为了好看，会在表面一层下功夫，就算要刻纹路也应该在表面刻。
Generally speaking, in order to look good, the necklace will work the surface layer, even if it is to engrave the pattern, it should be engraved on the surface.
可这条项链的主链却只在表面刻有淡淡水纹，转而在看不到的竹节里面雕刻了更复杂的纹路。

该书提到一个很关键的地方，就是高级药剂为什么难以炼制，就是因为它使用的药材都是高等级的药材，如果低等级的药师去处理这些药材，会无法锁住其中相应魔力，更无法让几种药剂互相融合起到应有的反应。
The book mentions a very key point, that is, why high-grade potions are difficult to refine, is because the medicinal materials used are all high-grade medicinal materials, and if low-level pharmacists deal with these medicinal materials, they will not be able to lock the corresponding magic power in them, let alone let several potions fuse with each other to have the desired reaction.
所以低等级的药师去炼制超越自己实力等级的药物，特别容易炸锅。
Therefore, it is especially easy for low-level pharmacists to refine drugs that exceed their own strength level.
那么如何处理这个问题？ So how to deal with this?
书中给出了两种解决方法，一种就是把药材微小化、把炼制步骤更加细化，把一个也许只需要三五个步骤就能炼制出来的药剂，分成十几个步骤去做。
There are two solutions given in the book, one is to miniaturize the medicinal materials and refine the refining steps, and divide a potion that may only need three or five steps to refine into more than a dozen steps.
就好像把一个仪器拆成无数零件，把这些小零件都做好后，再拼装起来。
It's like taking an instrument apart into countless parts, making all these small parts, and then putting them together.
这种做法的好处就是不用一开始就需要特别高的操控能力，也就不需要炼制者本人必须是高等级。
The advantage of this approach is that it does not require a particularly high level of control ability from the beginning, and it does not require the refiner himself to be a high level.
坏处是零件做得太多，很容易出错，拼装起来也很容易出问题，需要极为耐心和细心，而且会看出大量的拼装痕迹，没有那么纯粹和完美。
The disadvantage is that there are too many parts, it is easy to make mistakes, and it is easy to have problems when assembling, which requires extreme patience and care, and a large number of assembly traces will be seen, which are not so pure and perfect.
现在绝大多数能越级炼制药剂或者魔器的技师们，用的就是这种方法。
Now the vast majority of technicians who can leapfrog the refining of potions or magic weapons use this method.
还有一种方法，就是利用精神力进行辅佐炼制。 There is also a way to use spiritual power to assist in refining.
这本书的重点也不是第一种方法，而是重点描述如何利用精神力来弥补能量缺乏的缺憾，以及如何利用精神力来越级制作药剂。
The focus of this book is not on the first method, but on how to use mental power to make up for the lack of energy, and how to use mental power to make potions beyond the level.

“我不清楚中间经历了什么。也许神眷者和魔族发生了大战，也许还有其他原因，总之，双月星在很漫长的一段时间内，都再也见不到魔族，神眷者也成了稀罕物。”

疯药王虚虚拍了个巴掌：“我明白了！你是在说当年知识之城会被毁灭，就是因为这些老怪物的研究出了问题，他们控制不住他们研究出来的怪物了，这些怪物跑出来，在城中肆意祸害。比如这个石头人，它吃了一条街。如果有更多石头人呢？还有那些飞行怪物，以及你们在路上碰到的各种乱七八糟怪物。这些怪物全都跑出来……啊啊啊！”

Are you saying that the city of knowledge will be destroyed back then, because there is a problem with the research of these old monsters, they can't control the monsters they have researched, and these monsters run out and wreak havoc in the city. For example, this stone man, it ate a street. What if there were more stone people? And the flying monsters, and all the messy monsters you come across along the way. These monsters all ran out...... Ahhh ”

Wang Ye's eyes were very bright, and he had a more daring speculation: "I suspect that the old monsters who did research back then are likely to have created a very terrifying new monster. It has talents and qualifications far beyond ordinary geniuses, and has a powerful body, but just when the old monster was about to transfer its soul to this body, something happened to it, and perhaps this created body had its own consciousness. Of course, it's also possible that the old monster who wants to take it away has some kind of problem on its own. ”
“总之，这个强大到变态的怪物很可能把创造出它的老怪物们都干掉了，它还放出了其他怪物，导致知识之城大乱。”

Hearing this, Lei Mu also understood what Wang Ye's conjecture was: "Do you think that the powerful monster that was created took over the City of Knowledge and set new rules here, turning this place into a city of life?" ”
王叶点头：“对。而且这个强大怪物很可能想法十分矛盾，它既痛恨人类，可又把自己当人类看。它甚至可能觉得自己距离神已经不远，但它的实力又还没有真正到达神灵的程度。它也许很想离开这个秘境，但双月星魔法界不允许，很可能那个强大怪物也是被困在了这个秘境中。”

It may be tempted to leave this secret realm, but the Twin Moon Star Magic Realm does not allow it, and it is likely that the powerful monster is also trapped in this secret realm. ”
